title: Dhurandhar and Ramayana have 2 parts each, but Anil Sharma goes FOUR steps ahead; confirms Arjun Naga will be a four-part saga
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

According to a report in Mid-Day, Arjun Naga will be set against the backdrop of Dubai's oil rush in the 1960s. The story will explore the period surrounding the discovery of oil in the emirate's Fateh field in 1966, a landmark development that eventually helped transform Dubai from a modest fishing and trading hub into a global economic powerhouse.

Adding to this, A source told Mid-Day, “The story will begin when Dubai was still a small fishing and trading centre with dusty roads and simple homes. It will capture how an oil exploration concession was given to the Continental Oil Company in 1963, leading to years of drilling before oil was discovered. Arjun Naga will explore the fictional characters’ power dynamics against the emirate’s changing landscape and how their fortunes turned with the oil rush. Utkarsh’s character will rise from extreme poverty to become one of the richest men in Dubai.”

Meanwhile, The article also carried a quote by Anil Sharma who verified, “ Arjun Naga is about Dubai’s oil rush in the 1960s. We are making the movie in four parts, and it will have 10-12 top actors in pivotal roles spread across these instalments. The title will change with each part. We will shoot in Mumbai, Rajasthan, other parts of India, Dubai, and other international cities.”
Notably, While Utkarsh Sharma plays the lead role, Arjun Rampal has been signed as the antagonist. Of late, it came to light that Randeep Hooda and Celina Jaitly have joined the period drama.
As per the latest buzz, Bollywood Hungama had exclusively revealed in August 2026 that Himesh Reshammiya has been signed to compose the music for Arjun Naga .

title: EXCLUSIVE: Ayushmann Khurrana-Sara Ali Khan starrer Udta Teer DENIED release permission in Nepal
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood Hungama has learned that Udta Teer has not been granted permission for public screening in Nepal. Bollywood Hungama is in possession of a copy of the official order, which was communicated to the makers by Bishal Bhandari, Section Officer, Ministry of Communication and Information Technology, Government of Nepal.

Adding to this, The letter further shared that permission was denied as the movie falls under the subject matter prohibited by Section 5(3) of the Movie (Production, Exhibition and Distribution) Act, 2026 B.S.
Meanwhile, The letter was issued on Ashwin 30, 2083, as per Nepal's Bikram Sambat calendar, which corresponds to Friday, October 16, 2026, in the Gregorian calendar.

Notably, Udta Teer stars Ayushmann Khurrana, Sara Ali Khan, the late Mukul Dev and several others. Written and directed by Akash A Kaushik, the movie is produced by Karan Johar, Adar Poonawalla and Apoorva Mehta's Dharma Productions, along with Guneet Monga Kapoor and Achin Jain's Sikhya Entertainment.

As per the latest buzz, The movie tells the story of a Pakistani spy who infiltrates India but ends up losing his memory. In an unexpected turn of events, he begins believing that he is a hardcore Indian patriot, leading to chaos and madness.

title: Aruna Irani returns to work two months after husband Kuku Kohli’s death, thanks fans for love and support in emotional video
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Veteran Bollywood star Aruna Irani ’s husband, filmmaker Kuku Kohli , died of a heart attack at the age of 77 on August 25, 2026. Two months after his death, Aruna has opened up that she has resumed work and expressed gratitude to her followers for standing by her during this difficult time.

Adding to this, Aruna Irani returns to work after husband Kuku Kohli's death. Arun Irani shares first video after husband Kuku Kohli's death On Sunday, Aruna posted on Instagram to share an emotional video thanking her followers for their love and support following Kuku’s death. She shared, “After Kuku Ji's death, for the love you all gave me and supported me, I am truly grateful. I couldn't believe that in my tough times you guys stood by me. It's because of your love and support that I am standing in front of you and am able to resume work again. Asha karti hoon ki aap sab, meri zindagi ki aakhri saas tak yun hi mere saath rahenge (I hope you guys will stand by me like this till my last breath).”
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Aruna Irani (@arunairanikohli)

Notably, Kuku Kohli, best known for launching Ajay Devgn with the movie Phool Aur Kaante, died at the age of 77. The filmmaker was admitted to Kokilaben Dhirubhai Ambani Hospital on August 24 after he began feeling unwell. Balraj Irani, Aruna Irani’s brother, told India Today, “He (Kuku) was absolutely fine, and then this evening he suffered a massive heart attack. He was talking to us and just collapsed.”

As per the latest buzz, Despite doctors’ efforts to revive him, the filmmaker was declared dead at around 5 pm on August 25. He was cremated around noon on August 26. His wife, veteran star Aruna Irani, appeared emotional as she bid farewell to her husband alongside members of the Irani and Kohli families. Several people were seen assisting her as she made her way to the cremation.

In further updates, Several Bollywood celebrities, including Vicky Kaushal, Katrina Kaif, Sham Kaushal and Rohit Shetty, attended the funeral to pay their last respects. Some of Kuku’s memorable films include Suhaag, Haqeeqat, Kohram and Anari No. 1. The filmmaker is survived by his wife, star Aruna Irani, and his two daughters, Pooja and Karishma, from his first marriage to Rita Kohli.

On top of that, Aruna began her career as a child star and went on to establish herself in the movie industry, delivering memorable performances in negative and supporting roles. Some of her notable films include Caravan, Bobby, Beta, Raja Babu and Dil To Pagal Hai. She has also made her mark on television with shows such as Des Mein Niklla Hoga Chand and Jhansi Ki Rani. title: Bigg Boss 19 fame Abishek Bajaj recalls playing football with Tiger Shroff hours before shooting attack on him: ‘He’s safe now'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Tiger Shroff was playing football with television actors Abhishek Bajaj and Karan Veer Mehra just hours before gunmen opened fire at his car in Mumbai’s Juhu area. Following the incident, in an interview with News18, Abhishek spoke about playing football with Tiger and expressed relief that the star was safe.

Adding to this, Abhishek Bajaj shares update about Tiger Shroff after firing incident. Abhishek Bajaj recalls playing football with Tiger Shroff hours before the firing incident Abhishek, who was at the football ground before the shooting took place, verified that he had played with Tiger shortly before the incident. Speaking about the attack, he told News18, “Yes, we were playing together before the incident happened. We are fine. He’s safe now. No need to worry at all.”

Meanwhile, Television star Karan Veer Mehra, who was also present at the location, recalled what happened after the group left the football ground. Karan Veer shared his car was travelling directly behind Tiger’s vehicle when the shooting took place. In an interview, Karan Veer shared, “My car was right behind, you know, by the time we left the gate, by the time my car reached, I just saw blood spots, and I got to know that Tiger’s driver had been shot. So, I’m just happy that, you know, he’s safe, but my heart goes out to the driver, and I hope he recovers well... There were kids right there, celebrating a birthday party; everybody ran helter-skelter.”

Notably, Karan Veer also recalled the confusion at the scene, where people initially struggled to understand what had happened. He shared that there were people taking photographs and others celebrating a birthday with fireworks nearby. When they heard gunshots and people shouting that someone had opened fire, they initially thought the sounds could be connected to the fireworks. The situation became clearer when they learnt that Tiger’s driver had been shot.

As per the latest buzz, On Sunday, Tiger was leaving a club in Pushpa Park, Juhu, after playing football with friends when three bike-borne gunmen allegedly fired at least five rounds at his car. The star’s driver and an autorickshaw driver were injured in the incident.

In further updates, After his driver was injured, Tiger took over the wheel. Sources at Nanavati Hospital shared that the driver had sustained a gunshot wound to his left hand and might require surgery. Tiger, meanwhile, suffered minor abrasions. He was examined at the hospital and later discharged.

On top of that, Following the shooting, a forensic team examined the scene, inspected the vehicle and collected ballistic evidence to establish the number of rounds fired. Police also reviewed CCTV footage from surrounding areas as part of their efforts to identify the people involved in the attack. A person was later detained in Santacruz in connection with the case.

Two alleged operatives of the Lawrence Bishnoi gang, Anil Pandit and Harman Sandhu, subsequently claimed responsibility for the shooting in social media posts. However, the authenticity of their claims remained to be verified by the police.

title: Film workers' body demands protection for Tiger Shroff after shooting incident
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The Federation of Western India Cine Employees (FWICE) has condemned the firing incident involving Bollywood star Tiger Shroff 's vehicle, demanding security measures for the Heropanti star and his family members.

Adding to this, Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde, right, during a meeting with Bollywood star Tiger Shroff after unidentified assailants allegedly attacked the star's vehicle on Oct. 18, in Mumbai. (DCM PRO) "Such acts of violence and intimidation are completely unacceptable and raise serious concerns about the safety and security of personalities associated with the Indian movie industry. It is deeply disturbing that this is the second such incident involving a prominent personality from the movie industry, following the earlier firing incident involving renowned filmmaker Mr. Rohit Shetty. The recurrence of such incidents is a matter of grave concern and calls for immediate, decisive and effective action by the concerned authorities," read a statement issued by FWICE.
Meanwhile, FWICE called for a "thorough, impartial and time-bound investigation into the incident so that those responsible are identified and brought to justice."

Notably, "We appeal to the Government of Maharashtra and the concerned police authorities to take serious cognizance of these repeated attacks and implement effective measures to ensure a safer and more secure environment for all personalities associated with the movie industry," the organisation urged the authorities.

As per the latest buzz, Meanwhile, Mumbai Police has formed 15 teams to probe the shooting incident. As per the latest update, the police have recorded the statement of Tiger's driver, Firdous, who sustained a gunshot wound to his left hand.

In further updates, According to Deputy Commissioner of Police (DCP) Mohit Garg, Tiger Shroff narrowly escaped injury after unidentified individuals opened fire as he was leaving the football club in his car at around 7 pm on Sunday.

On top of that, Two people, including the star's driver, sustained injuries in the incident that happened in Mumbai's Juhu area. The driver was as per reports struck by bullets, while the star escaped without any gunshot injuries.

After news emerged that the star was targeted in a shooting, Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde visited his residence on Sunday night to enquire about his well-being and to assure him of the state government's support.

title: Karan Veer Mehra recalls chaos after gunshots were fired at Tiger Shroff in Mumbai, says he saw blood spots
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Tiger Shroff was returning from a football match when three unidentified gunmen opened fire at his car in Mumbai’s Juhu area. While the star escaped with minor abrasions, his driver suffered a gunshot wound. Television star Karan Veer Mehra , who was playing football with Tiger and whose car was right behind the star’s when the shooting took place, has narrated what he witnessed at the scene.

Adding to this, Karan Veer Mehra talks about gunshots fired at Tiger Shroff's car. Karan Veer Mehra shares details on Tiger Shroff's firing incident In a conversation with NDTV, Karan Veer opened up that his car was just behind Tiger’s vehicle. He shared, “My car was right behind, you know, by the time we left the gate, by the time my car reached, I just saw blood spots, and I got to know that Tiger’s driver had been shot. So, I’m just happy that, you know, he’s safe, but my heart goes out to the driver, and I hope he recovers well... There were kids right there, celebrating a birthday party; everybody ran helter-skelter.”

Meanwhile, He added, “And there were a lot of people who were taking photographs. We just heard some gunshots and people shouting that somebody had fired because there were also people celebrating with fireworks. So, we thought it was something to do with that.”

Notably, Karan Veer shared he had known Tiger for a long time and described him as a respectful person who remained focused on his work. He expressed sadness over the incident, adding that he knew Tiger’s family well and found it traumatising to see them go through such an ordeal. He also recalled that followers standing outside began shouting after hearing gunshots, disrupting the fireworks taking place nearby. Security personnel were alerted, and the police were called. By then, Tiger had already left the scene with his driver.

As per the latest buzz, Tiger was returning home after a football match in Juhu when three bike-borne gunmen allegedly fired at least five rounds at his car. The star’s driver and an autorickshaw driver who was passing by were injured. However, Tiger escaped with “minor abrasions”, according to sources at Nanavati Hospital.

In further updates, A forensic team visited the scene to collect ballistic evidence, inspect the vehicle and ascertain the exact number of rounds fired. Police also analysed CCTV footage from surrounding locations to identify the assailants. Later, one person was detained in Santacruz in connection with the case.

On top of that, Soon after the shooting, two alleged operatives of the Lawrence Bishnoi gang, Anil Pandit and Harman Sandhu, claimed responsibility for the attack in posts on various social media platforms. However, the police are yet to verify the authenticity of these claims.

The All India Cine Workers Association condemned the shooting. Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis and Deputy Chief Minister Eknath Shinde also visited the star’s residence and assured him that appropriate action would be taken against the gunmen.

title: INDIA bloc Nov 1 rally to have wider stakeholders; students and civil society groups to join protest
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The INDIA bloc’s soon-to-release rally in New Delhi to demand the removal of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar will include students bodies and civil society organisations, people familiar with the matter shared, adding that the initiative is in line with Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi ’s position that “all protests are one.

Adding to this, Karnataka Chief Minister DK Shivakumar, Congress leaders Rahul Gandhi, Imran Pratapgarhi and Deepender Singh Hooda, RJD leader Tejashwi Yadav, and other INDIA bloc leaders proceed in a bus towards the Supreme Court. (PTI) On September 29, the opposition INDIA bloc parties met in New Delhi to announce a series of protests to demand Gyanesh Kumar’s removal. It included a rally at the Ramlila Maidan on November 1. The original plan included the opposition allies but with students and civil society bodies rapidly engaging with protests, the changed political situation prompted the grouping to include the students and other organisations in the rally.

Meanwhile, “The rally will include members of civic society and students. There are no divisions. All of us are working together,” Trinamool Congress Rajya Sabha member Derek O’Brien shared on Sunday.

Notably, The proposed Ramlila Maidan rally comes close on the heels of a series of demonstrations in the Capital against the CEC that included a march to the Supreme Court and another from Parliament to the Rahstrapati Bhavan to meet President Droupadi Murmu . The protests led to a fresh confrontation between the Opposition and the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP), with Union home minister Amit Shah pointing out that the Congress was out of power in states such as Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal, Gujarat, Tamil Nadu for decades, questioning the validity of the Opposition’s argument against SIR.

As per the latest buzz, In the last gathering of INDIA bloc leaders at Rahul Gandhi’s Sunehri Bagh road residence, prominent student leaders including AISA president Neha Bora and Aishe Ghosh of SFI were invited along with civil activists Yogendra Yadav and advocate Prashant Bhushan. Bora was also invited to address the press. Two days later, Gandhi met the NSUI and IYC leaders who were injured or got cases filed against them during the protests.

In further updates, It is not clear if the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) will get an invitation to join the November 1 rally. During the past two weeks, the Congress has changed its stance vis-a-vis the CJP: from dubbing it as a front of the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) to Rahul Gandhi recognising the outfit’s protests. When CJP activists were arrested trying to go to Jantar Mantar to wave the Tricolour, Gandhi took to X to air his views. “Waving the Tricolour at Jantar Mantar in a peaceful protest is not a crime. Jailing youth for it is an act of cowardice. Students. Youth. Journalists. The INDIA bloc. Different banners, one cause. All protests are one: citizens demanding their constitutional rights. Jantar Mantar belongs to the people of India. We will reclaim it,” he shared.
On top of that, When asked if CJP will join the rally, O’Brien shared all are more than welcome.

CPI(ML) Liberation chief Dipankar Bhattacharya shared, “These details are being worked out. A coordination committee will be set up soon to oversee the plans for the protests and chalk out the details.”

body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Saurav Das, chief spokesperson of CJP, Ashutosh Ranka, co-convenner of CJP, and Ajinkya Shinde pose for a picture from, what the party says, inside the Parliament Street Police Station at a location given as New Delhi, India, in this handout image rolled out on October 14, 2026. Delhi protest LIVE: Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke has alleged “deliberate prolonging” of CJP convenors Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das's arrest, even as the two remain in judicial custody. Ranka and Das had been sent to five-day judicial custody on October 13, after they climbed a locked gate to enter the Jantar Mantar, which had earlier been de-notified as a protest site. The two, along with other CJP workers, had displayed the Tricolour at the site, and were eventually detained and placed under preventive arrest. They were then sent to judicial custody by a special executive magistrate. ...Read More

Adding to this, As their custody enters the sixth day on Sunday, Dipke alleged, “The state is deliberately prolonging Ashu and Saurav’s illegal arrest by using every dirty trick in the book to delay court proceedings and prevent their rollout.” He added, “They have no legal grounds to keep them behind bars, so they are resorting to delaying tactics to keep them there.” The special executive magistrate hearing their bail matter on Sunday had cited threats and mental harassment, leaving the duo’s rollout unresolved. Delhi Police lodges FIR The Delhi Police lodged an FIR on the complaint of SEM. Police denied allegations of delay and shared due procedure is being followed. Police Cite Plans for Another Protest During the hearing, police alleged that CJP leaders Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were planning another protest. Police cited Dipke’s reported remarks at the airport on Sunday that the party will strategise its next course of action. However, a CJP spokesperson shared they have no protest planned and are not even posting about it on social media. title: Long distance: India’s protest sites drift from power centres
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Vinay Sreenivasa spent three years fighting the restriction of protests in Bengaluru to a single, low-visibility ground: Freedom Park, the site of a former central jail in Gandhi Nagar. So, when flash protests erupted across Delhi last week — small groups marching through Connaught Place, Sansad Marg and Dilli Haat INA, with some even attempting to reclaim the barricaded stretch of Jantar Mantar after it was denotified as a designated site — the lawyer-activist who runs the Campaign for the Right to Protest recognised the pattern.

Adding to this, Activists hold placards with slogans reading 'Reclaim Jantar Mantar', 'Rollback SIR', and 'Gyanesh Kumar Must Resign' during a protest march organized by Justice Morcha from the Press Club of India to Jantar Mantar, (PTI) It is not just in Bengaluru and Delhi that the geography of protest has been shifting. In several major cities across the country, demonstrations are increasingly being channelled into designated spaces away from centres of power and public attention.

Meanwhile, Urbanists and activists say this is changing not just where citizens can make their voices heard, but also how public spaces are used, who gets access to them, and what role they play in a city’s political life.

Notably, “What the cities are trying to do is exercise spatial control and lock up dissent. Public spaces should be left to the public,” Sreenivasa shared. “Protest should be allowed at the relevant site: outside the municipal office that has ordered an eviction, outside the transport corporation that has hiked bus fares, anywhere in the city where the grievance arises. But, that is no longer possible,” he added.

As per the latest buzz, In Mumbai, large protests that could once be organised at Girgaon Chowpatty, Hutatma Chowk and August Kranti Maidan are now concentrated in a heavily policed corner of Azad Maidan. In Chennai, demonstrations that were once held along the open promenade of Marina Beach have been restricted to designated inland stretches such as Valluvar Kottam and Swami Sivananda Salai.

In further updates, In Kolkata, processions that once moved freely through the Maidan and Esplanade are now often directed into small, cordoned lanes such as Rani Rashmoni Avenue or the gated enclosure of Metro Channel (Y-Channel).

On top of that, “Where citizens are allowed to protest in a city reflects how a city accommodates dissent,” shared Aditya Sharma, an author who participated in the recent Jantar Mantar protests. “The distance between a protest site and the seat of power can determine how visible a grievance becomes, how easily people can gather and whether those in power can see, hear or ignore them.”

In Bengaluru, the restrictions came in stages. Under a 2009 order, protests involving more than 250 people required a licence, but demonstrations were not confined to a single venue. In 2021, after protests disrupted morning traffic, a high court judge wrote to the chief justice, triggering a suo motu public interest litigation. While the case was pending, the police commissioner issued a new order, which came into effect in early 2022 and restricted protests to Freedom Park.

title: Prahaar box office collection day 3: Rajkummar Rao film crosses ₹9 crore, surpasses lifetime haul of Kangana Ranaut’s Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Prahaar ticket-window earnings Day 3: Rajkummar Rao’s latest movie, Prahaar : The Ujjwal Nikam Story, opened to a slow start at the ticket-window on Friday. The movie witnessed a rise in collections over the weekend, but the growth was not substantial enough to give its overall earnings a major boost. Here’s a look at the movie’s box-office performance.

Adding to this, A still from Prahaar. Prahaar ticket-window earnings Day 3 Prahaar : The Ujjwal Nikam Story opened in theatres on Friday, October 16, earning ₹ 2.35 crore rupees in India net collections, according to Sacnilk. With an occupancy of 13%, the movie had a modest start, making it one of the lower openers in Rajkummar Rao’s career.

Meanwhile, The movie witnessed an improvement on Saturday, collecting ₹ 3.15 crore rupees, a jump of around 34% over its opening-day figures. Its occupancy also rose to 17%, indicating some growth in audience turnout over the weekend. On Sunday, the movie continued its theatrical run almost at the same pace, earning ₹ 3.50 crore rupees . This brings the movie's total net India collection to ₹ 9 crore rupees.

Notably, Despite its modest opening, Prahaar surpassed the collections of some recent Hindi releases. Imtiaz Ali’s critically acclaimed movie Main Vaapas Aaunga collected around ₹ 5.5 crore rupees during its first three days in theatres. Prahaar crossed this number within the first two days of rollout. The movie has also surpassed the lifetime India net collection of Kangana Ranaut’s Bharat Bhhagya Viddhaata , which collected ₹ 7.04 crore rupees.

As per the latest buzz, Prahaar is also competing at the ticket-window with Yami Gautam’s Nayyi Navelli. The movie, which rolled out on the same day, has stayed ahead of Prahaar and has crossed the ₹ 10 crore rupees mark within the same period.

In further updates, Directed by Avinash Arun and produced by Dinesh Vijan under Maddock Films, Prahaar: The Ujjwal Nikam Story is a biographical courtroom drama starring Rajkummar Rao as public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam.

On top of that, The movie revisits some of the landmark cases handled by Nikam- the prosecution of Ajmal Kasab, the lone surviving terrorist captured after the 2008 Mumbai attacks. It also explores the legal battles and challenges involved in pursuing justice in high-profile criminal cases. The cast includes Wamiqa Gabbi, Jaideep Ahlawat, Sikandar Kher and Lalit Prabhakar, who plays Kasab.

title: Nayyi Navelli box office collection day 3: Yami Gautam's film crosses ₹10 crore mark, beats Haq opening weekend haul
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Nayyi Navelli ticket-window earnings day 3: Yami Gautam and Adinath Kothare-starrer Nayyi Navelli has had a slow start at the ticket-window but witnessed some growth over its opening weekend, crossing the ₹ 10 crore rupees mark. However, despite the weekend boost, the movie’s box-office performance has remained modest amid competition from other releases, including Prahaar : The Ujjwal Nikam Story, Jailer 2 and Ranabaali.

Adding to this, Yami Gautam in a still from Nayyi Navelli. Nayyi Navelli ticket-window earnings Day 3 According to Sacnilk, the mythological drama began its box-office journey on Friday, earning ₹ 3.25 crore rupees in India net collections, with an occupancy of 11% across 6,281 shows. The movie registered an increase in collections on Saturday, earning ₹ 4 crore rupees and recording an occupancy of 14% across 5,945 shows.
Meanwhile, On Sunday, the movie continued its weekend run almost at the same pace, earning ₹ 4.30 crore rupees . This brought the movie's total net collection in India to ₹ 11.55 crore rupees .

Notably, Despite its modest box-office performance, Nayyi Navelli has surpassed Yami Gautam’s previous movie, Haq, which collected ₹ 8.95 crore rupees in India net collections during its first three days of rollout. However, the latest rollout remains behind some of Yami’s stronger theatrical performers. Her movie Article 370 collected ₹ 22.9 crore rupees in India net collections during its first three days, while OMG 2, in which she played a key role, collected more than ₹ 40 crore rupees over its opening weekend.
As per the latest buzz, The coming weekdays will be crucial for Nayyi Navelli as it looks to maintain its momentum and build on its opening-weekend collections.

In further updates, Nayyi Navelli stars Yami Gautam and Adinath Kothare and blends comedy with horror. Written by Himanshu Sharma and Divy Nidhi Sharma, the movie is directed by Kollywood filmmaker Balaji Mohan, marking his Bollywood directorial debut. It is produced by Aanand L Rai and Himanshu Sharma.

On top of that, A part of Hindustan Times'review read, "Nayyi Navelli is a movie that mistakes excess for entertainment and confusion for complexity. Its basic storyline offers enough scope for a blend of mythology and comedy, but the execution fails to do justice to the ideas. The screenplay needed sharper writing, yet it keeps piling on subplots and eccentric characters, hoping that something will eventually click. Yami tries to hold things together, but even her performance cannot compensate for the narrative's shortcomings. ‘Nayyi Navelli’ may mean something new, but there is precious little that's fresh about the movie itself."

title: Exclusive| From being a Kanjak to hosting one, Divya Dutta says: It’s role reversal for me
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Kanjak Pujan, also known as Kanya Pujan, is observed on Ashtami or Navami during Navratri, when young girls are worshipped as manifestations of Goddess Durga. For star Divya Dutta , who celebrates the ritual every year, it has taken on a special meaning as she now welcomes her niece and other young girls for the puja.

Adding to this, Divya Dutta with her niece “Today, it’s role reversal for me. I celebrate with my niece and other girls, wash their feet and seek blessings. It’s about respecting and loving girls as a roop of Mata Rani,” she says.

Meanwhile, Her connection to the ritual dates back to her childhood in Delhi. “I would get at least 10 invites. One never felt as much in demand. There would be a competition among friends about who got the most invites,” she recalls.
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by HT City (@htcity)

As per the latest buzz, Her first memory of Kanjak Pujan remains particularly special. “An aunty a sked me to show my feet, poured water and cleaned it, after which she took aashirwad. I felt respected and looked up to, I will always hold that memory close to my heart,” she says.

In further updates, Her childhood memories also include the ritual’s traditional treats and token money. “My first token amount was ₹ 10. I kept it in my gullak and refused to share it with anyone,” she laughs. The traditional poori, halwa and channa, she adds, remain among the fond memories she associates with the festival.

title: 'Foreign nationals protesting in India a matter of concern': Chirag Paswan on Imran Khan's participation in Mumbai stir
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Union minister Chirag Paswan has criticised star Imran Khan for participating in protests against Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar and the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls in Mumbai earlier this month.

Adding to this, Chirag Paswan says star Imran Khan, who is not an Indian citizen, should not have taken part in protest against CEC Gyanesh Kumar. (HT Photo) In conversation with reporters in Patna, Paswan shared every Indian citizen had the right to protest against any issue, but the participation of a foreign national in such demonstrations was unacceptable.

Meanwhile, “I like the star and his work. But he should have realised that he did not become an Indian citizen merely by virtue of having worked in the country for so long. If Indian citizens take part in protests, I respect that. But when foreign nationals do so, it is a matter of concern. As part of the Union government, I am concerned about attempts to create anarchy in the country with the backing of foreign powers,” Paswan shared.

Notably, The Hajipur MP, who tried his hand at films before entering politics, was responding to questions about the ‘leave India’ notice issued to Khan, an Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) cardholder who has been accused of violating the Foreigners Act.

As per the latest buzz, Khan, the nephew of superstar Aamir Khan, was born in the United States and holds American citizenship. However, he was brought up in India and has been active in the movie industry for over a decade.

In further updates, Paswan also criticised Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi for proceeding with his political engagements in Goa, while Union Home Minister Amit Shah cancelled his scheduled programmes in Kolkata following a stampede at a Durga Puja pandal that claimed 19 lives.
On top of that, Paswan shared Shah had shown “sensitivity” by cancelling his engagements in the wake of the tragedy, contrasting his response with that of the opposition.

“It shows the difference in priorities. On the one hand, we have our home minister, who is sensitive towards a tragedy, and on the other, we have the opposition, for which nothing matters more than politics,” the Union minister shared.

title: Amit Trivedi makes a SHOCKING confession about Anurag Kashyap’s No Smoking: “Mujhe film dekh ke kuch samaj nahin aaya!”; reveals Shilpa Rao STRUGGLED to get him his Bollywood break
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

He shared, “While working in the field of advertising, I met Shilpa Rao. She used to sing a lot of ads in the studios regularly. I fell in love with her voice. Also, she was a wonderful person and we became close friends. One day, I expressed my wish of collaborating with her for an album. She agreed. The first song I made in collaboration with her was ‘ Dhol Yaara Dhol ’ (which later became a part in Dev D ; 2009). I wanted to create its music video and then pitch it to MTV or Sony. However, she was very ambitious. She took this and other songs to movie directors.”
Adding to this, When remarked that Shilpa Rao struggled on his behalf, Amit Trivedi guffawed and replied, “In a way, you can say that!”

Meanwhile, He added, “One fine day, she called me and shared, ‘I met Anurag Kashyap sir and I played some stuff. Tu aa ke milega kya ?’. I replied, ‘Why are you doing this? We are thinking of a music album and going independent. Yeh movie ki chakkar mein kahaan pad rahi hai yaar ? This is not my scene’. I was reluctant because I was inherently shy. The movie world seemed very overwhelming and intimidating for me. I thought ki main apni choti si duniya mein main theek hoon ! But Shilpa threw me into it and that’s how Anurag sir became the first personality whom I met.”

Notably, Amit Trivedi continued, “I had some apprehensions, but Anurag sir made me very comfortable. It was the time when Black Friday (2007) had just been rolled out and work was going on for No Smoking (2007). He even showed us No Smoking . For the first time, I saw a raw version of a movie without background score or dubbing. However, mujhe woh movie dekh ke kuch samaj nahin aaya (laughs). I started wondering what I would tell him if he asked me, ‘ Kaisi lagi movie’!”

title: Imran Khan gets notice from Foreigners Regional Registration Office asking him to show cause why his OCI tag should not be cancelled
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Days after his participation in a Mumbai protest seeking Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar 's resignation, star Imran Khan received a 'leave India' notice by the Mumbai office of the Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO) on Thursday. On Saturday, he filed a petition in the Bombay High Court challenging a notice issued by the Mumbai Police directing him to leave India.

Adding to this, Mumbai Police detained star Imran Khan among protesters at August Kranti Maidan during demonstrations supporting the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Several political parties and student organisations participated. Mumbai, India. Oct 10, 2026. (Photo by Raju Shinde/HT Photo) (Raju Shinde) (HT_PRINT) FRRO sends notice to Imran On Sunday, Imran received a second notice. A report from The Times of India states that the FRRO sent him a second notice, this time asking him to show cause why his Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) status should not be cancelled. The notice cites his presence at the August Kranti Maidan protest in support of CJP’s anti-CEC stir in Delhi. The notice says no police permission was granted for the protest, and a case was registered against him and other protesters for unlawful assembly.

Meanwhile, The FRRO has sought his response by 15 days, as the law provides for a hearing before any action is taken to revoke an OCI card under the provisions of the Citizenship Act, 1955. The FRRO acknowledged that FIR registration and detention by themselves are not conclusive proof of the allegations or an automatic ground for cancellation of his OCI registration, nor does participation, by itself, establish a ground for cancellation.

Notably, Earlier, the Foreigners Regional Registration Officer (FRRO) in Mumbai issued the notice, dated October 14, four days after police briefly detained Imran at a protest in Mumbai demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. A former BJP MP had complained to Mumbai Police about his participation, PTI reported.

As per the latest buzz, Two laws bear on cases like Imran's. The 2025 immigration law lets the government and authorised officials order any foreigner out of the country. The Citizenship Act, 1955, lays out separate rules for holders of an Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) card, a status open to foreign nationals of Indian origin.

In further updates, The notice, issued on the Bureau of Immigration's letterhead, says Imran has "contravened the provisions of the Immigration and Foreigners Act, 2025 and the Rules and Orders made thereunder". It cites two sections of the Act as its authority: Section 7, which permits the government to order a foreigner to leave, and Section 29, which permits it to remove one.

On top of that, The notice orders that Imran "shall not remain in India and shall depart from India on or before 28.10.2026". The star challenged the notice before the Bombay High Court, alleging that it failed to disclose any reasons or to give him an opportunity to respond to the alleged violations.

title: ‘Jantar Mantar is Everywhere’: Indian diaspora across the world stage anti-CEC protests after massive Delhi demonstrations
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

As protests against chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar continue across India, the Indian diaspora has also taken to the streets in cities around the world, expressing solidarity with demonstrators and raising concerns over democracy, electoral rights, and the right to dissent.

Adding to this, Protestors in London on October 17. (X/@dhruv_rathee) Under the call of ‘Jantar Mantar is Everywhere’, solidarity protests and gatherings are being organised across the world by the India diaspora. Protests took place in London and Erlangen (Germany) on October 16 with more joining the next day. On October 17, Indians in Germany (Göttingen, Berlin), Ireland (Dublin), Netherlands (The Hague), Sweden (Gothenburg), Finland (Helsinki), Canada (Toronto, Vancouver, Montreal), United States (Austin, Philadelphia, Los Angeles, Chicago) and Czech Republic (Prague) took to the streets to demand accountability from the CEC over the alleged irregularities. More demonstrations are being held today in Australia (Melbourne, Sydney and Brisbane) and New York City.

Meanwhile, Student Federation of India (SFI) UK and SFI Leeds jointly gave a call for solidarity protest outside the High Commission of India in London on October 16, demanding “electoral integrity and the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar”. While the demonstration was in progress, they were as per reports met with a counterprotest. They alleged that some “right-wing thugs” tried to disrupt the protest.

Notably, SFI organised another protest next day, on October 17, in front of Gandhi Statue at Parliament Square in London with YouTuber Dhruv Rathee as a ‘special speaker’. In the visuals shared by the student body and Rathee, over a thousand protestors were seen waving the Indian flag while shouting slogans of azadi and inquilab.

As per the latest buzz, Slogans of ‘ Har ghar, har ghar, Jantar Mantar; leke rahenge Loktantra (Every home, a Jantar Mantar, we will reclaim our democracy)’ were raised at a solidarity rally outside Consulate General of India in Toronto on October 17. The protestors read the Indian Constitution and recited poet Gorakh Pandey's work ‘ Unka dar ’ expressing their support for the people of India and their pursuit of “free, fair, and transparent democratic institutions.” In a post on Instagram with pictures of the demonstration, the organisers, Firdaus-é-Inquilab, wrote, “Gyanu, It's done Bro - Resign Now!”
In further updates, View this post on Instagram A post shared by International Socialists (IS) (@socialist.ca)
On top of that, The group, Indians in Vancouver, organised another solidarity gathering in Vancouver.

According to CBC News, Pablo Khan, who is originally from Mumbai, India, shared his brother and sister were detained by police in New Delhi while participating in Saturday’s protests against alleged electoral manipulation. The following day, Khan joined around 50 people in downtown Vancouver in a demonstration of solidarity with protesters in India and in support of the right to peaceful protest amid reports of mass detentions in New Delhi.

title: Amit Trivedi reveals Dev D was initially put on HOLD: “Ronnie Screwvala was not keen on making it”; recalls how he TREMBLED before presenting songs to Anurag Kashyap: "I feared this would be the first and last film of my career!"
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Amit Trivedi shared, “Anurag sir told me that he was doing a modern-day Devdas and that it had a requirement of some 12-15 songs. He shared some ideas and references. All this was very new for me. I went home and started working immediately. I took 6 months to compose 6 songs as my advertising work was also going on. 6 months later, Shilpa asked me for an update. I told her, ‘Are you sure you want to do this? Sir must have forgotten our meeting’. But she insisted that we had to meet him again.”

Adding to this, He continued, “Earlier, we met in Anurag sir’s office. This time, the meeting took place in my studio. Anurag sir came along with Vikas Bahl. Trust me, main kaanp raha tha . I was 26-27 years old. I had not seen Devdas . So, I saw both Dilip Kumar’s Devdas (1955) as well as Shah Rukh Khan’s Devdas (2002). That gave me an idea about the plot. Then, I composed as per what I understood. I feared ki main gaali khaunga and that this would be the first and last song of my career! However, they were so impressed and they liked all the songs.”

Meanwhile, Amit added, “The next day, they called me for narration. I didn’t know what that meant (laughs). I heard the story after which I composed two more songs – ‘Saali Khushi’ and ‘Pardesi’ . After listening to the tracks, Anurag sir tweaked a bit of the script and reimagined the movie. I was like, ‘Wow. Aisa bhi hota hain’ !”

Notably, He also shared, “Then, something happened. I don’t know exactly, but producer Ronnie Screwvala sir was not keen on making Dev D . So, the movie went on hold. Anurag sir met me and shared, ‘You have worked enough on Dev D. Tu abhi ruk jaa. Thoda hold pe hain . Meanwhile, I am producing a movie called Aamir (2008). Raj Kumar Gupta is directing it. You work on this movie while I figure out a way forward for Dev D ’.”

As per the latest buzz, Aamir , starring Rajeev Khandelwal, rolled out first and hence marked Amit Trivedi’s debut as a movie composer, even though Dev D was the first movie he had worked on. Dev D eventually rolled out eight months later.

title: EXCLUSIVE: Addinath M Kothare reveals 2 out of 5 ACs on Nayyi Navelli sets were reserved ONLY for him: “My sweat was dripping through the prosthetics; andar se mera body melt ho raha tha!”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

How has the response to your character in Nayyi Navelli been? It's been amazing so far. I am quite overwhelmed with the response that I am getting for my character. It's a festive family entertainer, which has been aptly rolled out during the festive season. Hence, it's lovely to be in this space right now.

Adding to this, The movie has a Dussehra connection. Is that why the makers decided to rollout it during this festive period? Absolutely. This is also why they fast-tracked the entire shoot. It was a very difficult movie to make due to the VFX, fantasy elements, ensemble cast, songs, etc. Yet, it was a very well-planned and efficiently executed project. We started shooting in April, and here we are. So, it's amazing!

Meanwhile, It's a passionately made movie. The kind of detailing that has gone into it and the efforts taken by the team deserve special mention. Ravi Srivastava, who has worked on films like Slumdog Millionaire (2008) and Lion (2016), handled the production design of our movie. Rishi Punjabi's cinematography is phenomenal. The whole team worked really hard. As for Aanand L Rai sir and Himanshu Sharma, they are master storytellers, as we all know (smiles).

Notably, Horror-comedy has become quite popular now, but you and your family have been pioneers in this genre. Your father, Mahesh Kothare, made the cult movie Zapatlela (1993), followed by Pachhadlela (2004), on which you worked as an assistant director. You also acted in Zapatlela 2 (2013). What are your thoughts on returning to this genre?

As per the latest buzz, (Laughs) Quite honestly, you can't plan or even predict these things. I feel blessed that I got a movie in this genre. I am also fortunate that two of my films are releasing quite close to each other. While Nayyi Navelli is a fantasy centred around mythology, Ramayana is a historical.
In further updates, How was your experience of working with Yami Gautam Dhar? It was amazing. Despite being such a big star, she is very grounded and easy to talk to. She was also extremely helpful.

On top of that, When you begin working on a movie, you are still searching for your character, his body language, etc. Moreover, the movie is set in Meerut, and I had to work a lot on the dialect, as I was the only non-North Indian star on the set! Thankfully, I was somewhat familiar with the accent because of the films we watch. So, it wasn't completely alien to me. Also, in Mumbai, you get to hear the UP accent quite often.

Nevertheless, I had to work a lot on the dialect and other aspects of the character. On my first or second day of the shoot, Yami, Balaji Mohan sir and I were having a conversation. Yami cracked a joke, and I laughed. As I laughed, she stared at me for a moment and shared, "Adi, this is Raja!" At that point, I was still trying to find the character. I knew I was close, but her observation helped push me in the right direction.

title: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash’s Ramayana set for historic world premiere at Academy Museum, guests asked to wear traditional attire | Exclusive
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Ranbir Kapoor -starrer Ramayana is set to make its mark in Hollywood as one of the few Indian films to host its world premiere at the prestigious Academy Museum of Motion Pictures’ David Geffen Theatre in Los Angeles. The grand premiere is scheduled for October 27.

Adding to this, Ramayana will rollout worldwide on November 5. Ramayana’s world premiere in Los Angeles The makers have officially revealed the movie’s grand world premiere in Los Angeles on October 27. The event will take place in the evening at the iconic Academy Museum of Motion Pictures, a prominent institution dedicated to celebrating the history, art and science of filmmaking.

Meanwhile, The museum has hosted several prestigious global events and Oscar-related celebrations over the years, further cementing its position as a landmark in the international movie industry. The premiere marks a significant moment for Ramayana as the makers prepare to introduce their ambitious Indian epic to an international audience.

Notably, With the celebrations coinciding with Diwali , the makers are also bringing India's festive spirit to Los Angeles. Guests have been requested to arrive in traditional Indian festive attire for their red-carpet appearances. The premiere will host a full-capacity audience of 945 guests, including leading Hollywood figures, filmmakers, international press and prominent members of the movie industry. The movie will be screened in 3D.

As per the latest buzz, Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra’s Prime Focus Studios in collaboration with DNEG and Yash’s Monster Mind Creations, Ramayana is envisioned as a two-part cinematic epic. The first instalment is scheduled for worldwide rollout on November 5, 2026, followed by the second part during Diwali 2027.

In further updates, The movie will rollout in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam. It is also set for an IMAX rollout, with Sony Pictures handling global distribution outside India and Dharma Productions distributing the movie in the Hindi-speaking market.

On top of that, Of late, Yash verified that the combined budget for both parts of Ramayana stands at ₹ 4,000 crore rupees. The star and producer also explained why the makers have been vocal about the scale of the ambitious project.

Speaking at the movie's new trailer launch in Bengaluru, he shared, “I know that Namit's statement went widely shared on social media. In India, there is a problem. People don't like it when you talk confidently. That's what happened with Namit's statement. But in the West, it's the total opposite. If you tell them we have made a good movie in a humble manner, they will dismiss our movie as a small project. That's exactly why Namit has confidently shared that this movie is mounted on ₹ 4,000 crore rupees. We need to prove the strength of the Indian movie industry to the global market."

title: Non-bailable arrest warrant issued on Rakhi Sawant in 2010 suicide case after she fails to appear at UP court
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

A court in Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh, has issued a non-bailable warrant against star Rakhi Sawant in a 2010 suicide case linked to alleged insulting remarks she made against a local resident on her television show, a government lawyer shared on Saturday.

Adding to this, Rakhi Sawant in legal trouble over comments she made on her TV show Rakhi Ka Insaaf. District Government Counsel (Crime) Mridul Kant Srivastava shared Civil Judge (Junior Division) Anjali issued the warrant on Friday after Rakhi repeatedly failed to appear before the court.

Meanwhile, According to PTI, the case relates to Laxman Ahirwar, a resident of the Hansari Prem Nagar area in Jhansi, who allegedly committed suicide on November 10, 2010, after being humiliated by remarks made by Rakhi on her television show, Rakhi Ka Insaaf, the lawyer shared.

Notably, Laxman's mother, Savitri, had lodged a complaint at the Prem Nagar police station, alleging that Rakhi had used insulting and objectionable language against her son during an episode of the show aired in October 2010.

As per the latest buzz, According to the prosecution, Laxman and his wife, Anita, who hailed from Rajgarh, had been invited to the show following marital discord. Anita had returned to her parental home after disputes between the couple.
In further updates, The next hearing in the case has been scheduled for December 1, Srivastava shared.

On top of that, Rakhi was of late in the news for her public comments on Govinda and Sunita Ahuja's marriage. She also reacted to his rumoured relationship with co-star Komal Rani Swarnkar. In conversation with the paparazzi earlier this month, Rakhi shared she was unhappy with Govinda for neglecting his wife. She shared, “Govinda ji, pura desh naaraz hai aapse (Govinda ji, the whole nation is upset with you). The woman who married you and gave birth to your two kids, who has been with you for 40 years, you left her. And who is this Komal?”

Rakhi then claimed that Komal had been badmouthing her and warned her against confronting her. She shared in Hindi, “She is badmouthing me and talking trash about other celebrities, too. Chichi Bhaiya is the one who gave her these wings. Listen, don't mess with me. I am not Sunita; I will tear you to shreds.” Rakhi went on to call Komal a “pati chor (husband stealer)”.

title: Vicky Kaushal adds garba twist to Tauba Tauba, Kriti Sanon dances to Param Sundari at Jamnagar Navratri celebration
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

After Sidharth Malhotra , Varun Dhawan and Shahid Kapoor, actors Kriti Sanon and Vicky Kaushal joined the star-studded lineup at the Reliance Jamnagar Navratri celebrations. Videos and photos of the actors performing at the garba event have been circulating on social media.

Adding to this, Vicky Kaushal and Kriti Sanon at Jamnagar Navratri celebration. Vicky Kaushal adds a garba twist to Tauba Tauba Vicky performed on Saturday, Day 7 of Navratri, and a video of him dancing to his hit track Tauba Tauba with a garba twist has gone widely shared on social media. He was seen wearing black pants and a traditional jacket for the performance. The star appeared to be in his element as he brought his signature moves to the festive stage. Vicky had also shared a poster of the event on his Instagram story.

Meanwhile, Kriti Sanon performed on Day 6 of Navratri at the Reliance township. Dressed in a pink lehenga set, the star set the stage on fire with performances of her hit songs, including Param Sundari and Tere Baaton Mein Aisa Uljha Jiya. Kriti later thanked the audience and shared how much she enjoyed dancing garba with the people of Jamnagar, and also noted that this was her first visit to Jamnagar.

Notably, Several Bollywood stars have been part of the Jamnagar Navratri celebrations this year. Varun Dhawan performed on Day 1, while Malaika Arora took to the stage on Day 3. Shahid Kapoor also entertained the audience with his performance on Day 5. Sidharth Malhotra and Taapsee Pannu had also performed at the Jamnagar Navratri celebration on day 2.

As per the latest buzz, Vicky Kaushal is gearing up for his next major project, Sanjay Leela Bhansali’s Love & War, which also stars Ranbir Kapoor and Alia Bhatt. The movie is among his much-anticipated projects and is scheduled for rollout on January 21, 2027. Vicky will also star in Mahavatar, directed by Amar Kaushik. The soon-to-release mythological drama will feature Vicky as Lord Chiranjeevi Parashurama, the eternal warrior of dharma. The star is expected to begin work on the mythological movie after wrapping up Love & War.

In further updates, Kriti Sanon, meanwhile, was last seen in Cocktail 2, directed by Homi Adajania and co-starring Shahid Kapoor and Rashmika Mandanna. The romantic drama was rolled out in June 2026. Kriti is as per reports set to reunite with Dinesh Vijan's Maddock Films for an untitled horror movie. The project is expected to see her explore a darker genre after her previous collaborations with the production house, including Bhediya and Cocktail 2.

On top of that, Vibha Maru is an Assistant Editor with Hindustan Times Entertainment, based in Delhi. With a decade of experience across digital and print media, she covers Bollywood, Hollywood and web shows. A self-confessed cinephile who breathes Hindi cinema, Vibha can often be found sacrificing sleep after binge-watching films and web series. Though she holds a Commerce degree, she discovered her true calling in journalism after enrolling at the Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC). She began her career covering Delhi's cultural scene, food, nightlife, concerts, and city life at The Times of India, before moving into full-time entertainment journalism with India Today. At India Today, Vibha interviewed some of the biggest names in Bollywood and television while carving a niche for herself through movie reviews, opinion pieces, nostalgic features, star interviews, and trend-driven stories. She later brought her storytelling and editorial expertise to The Indian Express, where she continued to deepen her understanding of cinema through long-form entertainment explainers, retrospectives and feature writing. Now, as Assistant Editor at Hindustan Times Entertainment, Vibha continues to chronicle the world of movies and pop culture. Her work spans breaking entertainment news, exclusive interviews, star features, and stories that capture the conversations shaping Indian cinema. Read More

title: Salman Khan reveals maternal grandfather opposed Salim Khan’s marriage to Salma Khan, didn’t speak to him for 5 years
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

While in conversation with contestants on Bigg Boss , Salman Khan often ends up sharing anecdotes from his personal life. Of late, the star recalled how his maternal grandfather did not speak to his father, screenwriter Salim Khan , for years because he disapproved of his marriage to Salman’s mother, Salma Khan.

Adding to this, Salman Khan spoke about his parents, Salim Khan and Salma Khan's marriage. Salman apologises to Salim Khan During the episode, Salman was speaking about the show’s zero-tolerance policy and how contestants often regret their actions. Talking about his personal life, the star opened up that he had of late apologised to his father and asked for his forgiveness if he had ever failed him or shared anything that hurt him.

Meanwhile, Salman went on to share the story of his maternal grandfather, who was upset about Salma’s marriage to Salim Khan. The star explained that his grandfather’s objection was not religious but stemmed from concerns about his daughter marrying someone from the movie industry.

Notably, He shared, “Let me tell you, when my parents got married, there was no religious connotation. Only my (maternal) grandfather was upset because my mom was marrying a good-looking man who aspires to be an star. His objection was that she was getting married to someone from the movie industry. My mom’s siblings were okay with this. They liked my father, but my grandfather wondered how his daughter would live in that atmosphere.”

As per the latest buzz, The star added, “He didn’t speak to my father for five years. When Sohail was born, my nana came from Mahim to Bandra with sweets. He expressed his regret over missing his grandchildren growing up, in conversation with the nicest man ever, because he had something on his mind. He had this regret till his last breath. Once or twice, when mom and dad fought, and mom went back to her house, my nana didn’t let her in. He told her, ‘Go back to your house; you can come anytime, but you will not come here after fighting.’”
In further updates, View this post on Instagram A post shared by JioHotstar Reality (@jiohotstarreality)

On top of that, Salim Khan and Salma Khan’s love story began when Salma, born Sushila Charak, and Salim lived in apartments opposite each other. The two fell in love and got married in 1964. After their marriage, Sushila adopted the name Salma. The couple went on to have four children: Salman, Arbaaz, Sohail Khan, and their daughter Alvira Agnihotri.

Years later, Salim Khan fell in love with star and dancer Helen while he was still married to Salma. The two married in 1981. Salim has spoken about how the decision was initially difficult for his family, while Salman has also recalled that it took time for him and his siblings to accept Helen as part of their family. Over the years, however, the family has spoken about their close bond and the relationship they share today.

title: Screen Ravanas who left a lasting impact: From NT Rama Rao, Arvind Trivedi, Akhilendra Mishra, Nitikin Dheer, Saif Ali Khan to Yash next
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

From filmmaker Dadasaheb Phalke ’s Lanka Dahan (1917) to Nitesh Tiwari ’s soon-to-release magnum opus two-part Ramayana, several films and TV shows on Shri Ram have been made, and one character who has outperformed and remained in audience memory has been that of the actors playing Lankapati Ravana.

Adding to this, (Clockwise from top left) Nikitin Dheer, Arvind Trivedi, Yash, NT Rama Rao, Rajniesh Duggal, Saif Ali Khan and Akhilendra Mishra in the role of Ravana From NT Rama Rao to TV’s OG Ravana played by Arvind Trivedi, many actors have essayed the role on screen and brought their own charm to it. Ahead of Dussehra , as we celebrate the victory over evil, we bring you some popular actors and the roles they played Ravana on screen.
Meanwhile, NT Rama Rao , Bhookailas (1958) and Sita Rama Kalyanam (1961)

Notably, One of the biggest icons of cinema, NT Rama Rao is probably the only star who played the roles of Shri Ram and Ravana on the big screen. In Lava Kusha (1963), he played Shri Ram, but prior to that he essayed the role of Ravana in Bhookailas (1958) and Sita Rama Kalyanam (1961). Interestingly, he played the role of Shri Krishna in a record 17 films.

As per the latest buzz, Ramanand Sagar’s cult TV show Ramayana , starring Arun Govil and Deepika Chikhlia in leading roles, saw star Arvind Trivedi playing the role of Ravana. The star became a household name for playing the role and is dubbed the OG Ravana on TV. Later, he was elected to the Lok Sabha, the lower house of the Parliament of India, from Sabarkantha, Gujarat.

In further updates, The star played the role in Anand Sagar’s 2008 Ramayan , where Gurmeet Singh and Debina Bonerjee played Ram-Sita. It is shared that initially Mishra was signed to play the role for six months and had even shot the killing scene and wrapped up his portion, but due to the huge response to the show, the shoot was extended further.

On top of that, Star Narendra Jha essayed the role of Lankapati in the TV serial titled Ravana , which aired from November 2006 and continued for over two years. This remains one of the most popular works of the late star.

title: Saif Ali Khan jokingly complains about not receiving 2 years' worth of ghee he won on Kaun Banega Crorepati yet: ‘Even my cheque's not come’
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

He added that he didn’t receive his cheque either.

Adding to this, Bollywood star Saif Ali Khan poses for photographs on the sets of Kaun Banega Crorepati. He also added, “Even my cheque’s not come,” making Kareena and Archana Puran Singh laugh. “Somebody get him his ghee,” joked one fan, posting a clip of the interaction on Instagram. “He's so unintentionally funny,” wrote another.

title: Rajpal Yadav thanks Supreme Court for allowing him to present his side in cheque bounce case: ‘Got opportunity after 14 years’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Star Rajpal Yadav on Saturday expressed his gratitude to the Supreme Court for presenting his side of the argument in the ongoing cheque bounce case against him.

Adding to this, Star Rajpal Yadav at the Supreme Court in connection with a cheque bounce case in which the Court had directed him to deposit ₹2 crore rupees with the Supreme Court registry, in New Delhi on Wednesday. (ANI Video Grab) Rajpal Yadav thanks Supreme Court While talking to ANI, Rajpal shared, "First of all, I want to thank the Supreme Court , because after 14 years, I finally got the opportunity to present my side of the story, and we will follow the Supreme Court's order at any cost. This lawsuit is the most interesting case in Indian history."

Meanwhile, "You've seen one innings for 12 to 14 years, but until the other innings are properly heard, how can this be resolved? If it were a matter of ₹ 5 crore rupees, it could have been settled. The issue is ₹ 22 crore rupees— ₹ 5 crore rupees killed ₹ 22 crore rupees. And even after killing ₹ 22 crore rupees, I am a public star who goes out among the people all over the world. But I shared on the first day that three allegations were made against me, that Rajpal committed fraud of ₹ 5 crore rupees. Rajpal took a loan. Rajpal cheated a businessman. Rajpal doesn't understand how he cheated, given all these checks. I think when there are so many agreements, there is no question of cheating, and someone who has won the hearts of the whole world would commit a ₹ 5 crore rupees fraud? That's mental," shared the star.

Notably, Rajpal also shared he would present his case during mediation in the ongoing cheque bounce case , stressing that he would accept any decision reached after hearing both sides. "Right now, we have the good fortune of mediation (court hearing). I will put my case in mediation; I always want a decision in life, and everyone wants a decision. But whatever decision is made after hearing both sides—that was acceptable before, it is acceptable today, and it will be acceptable tomorrow. One very interesting thing: I want to thank the Supreme Court for saying that there is no drama in court. I have been acting for 42 years, so my stomach is full," shared the star.

As per the latest buzz, "It has happened, but if this is a drama, then either the Governor is creating drama or the opposing party is. The one creating drama needs to be exposed, because I act in reels and I live in reality. I never play around with reality, because I have had the privilege of doing so much in reels," he added.

In further updates, Earlier this month, Rajpal appeared in person before the Supreme Court after the court’s stern warning over his failure to deposit the amount due in a cheque-bounce case. He told the Court that he would pay ₹ 2 crore rupees and showed a demand draft of ₹ 1.15 crore rupees.

On top of that, A buyer of his property, who is to pay the remaining ₹ 85 lakh, was also present in court. A bench of Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana directed Rajpal to deposit ₹ 2 crore rupees towards the amount due to the complainant by October 13.

The case relates to a loan of around ₹ 5 crore rupees allegedly taken by Rajpal from M/s Murli Projects Pvt Ltd in 2010 for his movie Ata Pata Laapata. Seven repayment cheques of ₹ 1.05 crore rupees each were subsequently dishonoured, leading to the cheque-bounce proceedings. The unpaid amount increased over the years with interest and other charges.

title: Addinath Kothare overwhelmed with the response to Nayyi Navelli, says the mythological fantasy film got a perfect release during Dussehra | Interview
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Addinath Kothare is on a roll this year. Ahead of the much-anticipated rollout of Ramayana next month (where he plays Bharath), he is back on screen as a lead opposite Yami Gautam in Nayyi Navelli . The mythological fantasy thriller has opened in theatres to positive reviews for the Marathi star, who has been working in the industry since he was a child. Apart from being an star, he is also a director and producer.

Adding to this, Addinath Kothare plays Yami Gautam's husband in the movie. Right after the rollout of Nayyi Navelli, HT caught up with Addinath for an exclusive chat where he opened up about the movie's reception and why he shared yes to the part in the first place.

Meanwhile, The star has read the comments and praise for his work in the movie, in which he is paired opposite Yami Gautam. He plays Raja Awasthi, who brings his newlywed wife Mohini to his house in Meerut, whose arrival in the large joint family triggers an unexpected mythological battle.

Notably, Talking about the response to the movie, Addinath says, “I am very overwhelmed by the appreciation that I am getting for my character and for the movie, in general. The kids are loving it the most, and that is a great sign. It is the festive season, and Nayyi Navelli is a family movie, so it is a great time for a movie like this to be rolled out. We keep working on big projects, and it takes a lot of luck and destiny for things to align, where the right project comes at the right time in theatres. I think there could not have been a better time for a movie like Nayyi Navelli to rollout in the middle of Dussehra.”
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Amazon MGM Studios India (@amazonmgmstudiosin)

In further updates, The star recalls how he was first approached about the movie's script while he was shooting a Television show he was also producing. It was Mukesh Chhabra who called him, and he knew it would be for something exciting. “He asked me, ‘How busy are you?’ and one thing is that as an star, we are very greedy, and when Mukesh Chhabra [casting director] calls you, it is exciting because he works on some of the best projects. He has an eye for great stories and great talent. I took that risk and shared that I was free!”

On top of that, Addinath shared he was really enamoured of the script after hearing it and meeting the team for the first time. “They told me the story, and I went ‘wow!’ It was a dream role. It was a delicious part for any star, and I knew I had to do this. I somehow managed to accommodate my dates after speaking with the channel heads, and that is how the movie happened,” he smiles.
Nayyi Navelli is directed by Balaji Mohan. It is currently playing in theatres nationwide.

title: Delhi protest LIVE: ‘CJP to restrategise after Das, Ranka's release; won’t back down,’ says Dipke
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Delhi protest LIVE: Following his rollout on Friday, Dipke shared he was “waiting for his brothers to be free”. Delhi protest LIVE: Cockroach Janta Party co-convenors Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka's five-day judicial custody ends on Saturday, and with the Delhi Police not having filed an extension plea yet, they may be rolled out. While CJP's legal affairs head Ratna Singh shared every required procedure regarding had been completed and they were “merely waiting for formal approval”, the outfit has warned of legal action if Das and Ranka are not rolled out today. The CJP shared they had consulted with senior advocate Kapil Sibal, and alleged “deliberate use of delaying tactics” to keep Das and Ranka “behind bars.” ...Read More

Adding to this, CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke was rolled out on Saturday on conditional bail, a day after he was detained on his way to Connaught Place for the ‘Lehra do Tiranga’ march and then arrested. One of the primary conditions of Dipke's bail bond is to ensure there is no breach of peace on his end for a period of one year. AISA national president Neha Bora had also been detained on Friday, but was rolled out following overnight detention after formal procedures under Section 65 of the Delhi Police Act. The CJP, student organisations and the Opposition have staged continuous protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and the special intensive revision exercise, following reports of objections being raised by the two Election Commissioners on the poll body's decisions. The ECI has, in a statement, maintained that all decisions taken by it are unanimous. ‘Waiting for my brothers to be free’ Following his rollout on Friday, Dipke shared he was “waiting for his brothers to be free”, while sharing a photograph of Das and Ranka. CJP's co-convenors were arrested earlier this week on Tuesday, after they jumped a locked gate to enter Jantar Mantar, which was de-notified as a protest site, and displayed the Tricolour there, along with 12 others. They were subsequently detained. While CJP national organisation in-charge Ajinkya Shinde and 11 others were rolled out, Das and Ranka faced preventive action and were sent to five-day judicial custody. CJP's legal affairs head Ratna Singh had, in a post on X, alleged that Das and Ranka “could not come out” on Saturday because the investigating officer (IO) had come at 6 pm for a 2 pm hearing.

Meanwhile, Delhi protest LIVE: With a 30-foot effigy of a cockroach to be burnt alongside those of Ravan, Meghnad and Kumbhkaran at a Ramlila event here, some social media users are questioning its propriety at a religious celebration while organisers maintain the initiative aims to promote cleanliness.

Notably, The Shree Keshav Ram Leela Committee, which organises the annual event in Pitampura, shared the cockroach symbolises filth and dirt and the initiative aims to spread awareness about cleanliness under 'Swachh Bharat' and 'Swachh Delhi' campaigns.

As per the latest buzz, Committee president and BJP MLA Ashok Goel told PTI that the decision is not politically motivated and is intended to convey the message of the victory of good over evil while highlighting the importance of cleanliness.
In further updates, The cockroach will be depicted among the 'asuras' in Ravan's army, he shared.

On top of that, The development comes amid protests by the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) in the capital. The group had initially protested against former education minister Dharmendra Pradhan, and has now joined demonstrations demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

Several social media users have questioned the decision, arguing that bringing contemporary political developments into a religious celebration could hurt sentiments and divert attention from the festival's traditional significance.

Adding to this, Prahaar ticket-window earnings day 2: Rajkummar Rao in a still from Prahaar. title: ‘Issued without inquiry, show-cause notice’: Imran Khan challenges notice to leave the country for taking part in anti-CEC protests, moves Bombay HC
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Imran Khan , a US citizen and an OCI cardholder, on Saturday filed a petition in the Bombay High Court challenging a notice issued by the Mumbai Police directing him to leave India by October 28 for allegedly violating rules by participating in a political demonstration. The star, who holds a US passport and an Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) card, was issued the notice following his participation in a protest against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

Adding to this, Police detained star Imran Khan among protesters at August Kranti Maidan during demonstrations supporting the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) protest against chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar (HT File Photo/Raju Shinde) Imran's plea before Bombay HC The latest update from news agency PTI states that the 43-year-old star, in the plea filed through his advocate Zulfiquar Memon and MZM Legal, termed the notice as "illegal, perverse, drastic and bad in law." The plea shared that there is no provision under the current law or statutory rules that prohibits an OCI (Overseas Citizen of India) cardholder from participating in a peaceful protest.

Meanwhile, The plea is expected to be mentioned for an urgent hearing before a division bench comprising Chief Justice Mahesh Chandra Tripathi and Justice Advait Sethna. "The notice has been issued without disclosing any reasons, supporting material, or specific statutory contravention. It was issued without inquiry, a show-cause notice, or any opportunity for the Petitioner (Khan) to respond to the alleged violations," the plea shared.

Notably, The row dates back to October 10, when Imran, nephew of Bollywood superstar Aamir Khan, participated in a demonstration organised by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP). The protest called for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. Imran and his girlfriend, Lekha Washington, were detained by Mumbai Police during the demonstration.

As per the latest buzz, Following his detention, Imran shared a photograph on social media that appeared to show him inside a police van. He captioned it, “Apparently I’m going for a drive”. In conversation with the media at the protest, the star explained why he had joined the demonstration. “I don’t have demands. I’m here as a citizen, as a person who lives in this city. I’m here to see why freedom of movement is being restricted, why people’s voices are being suppressed,” he shared.

In further updates, At the protests, Imran Khan shared he was not present at the protests with any specific demands, but had come forward in his capacity as "a citizen". He shared he wanted to understand why freedom of movement was being restricted and why people’s voices were being suppressed.

On top of that, “I don't have demands. I am here as a citizen, as a person who lives in this city. I am here to see why freedom of movement is being restricted. Why are people's voices being suppressed? That is why I am here,” the star shared in the video widely circulated on social media.

The star, his girlfriend Lekha Washington , his mother mother Nusrat, and niece Zayn (Marie) were detained along with 400 people at during the protest, demanding the resignation of CEC Kumar over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.
