title: Salman Khan recalls feeling a mysterious presence in his bedroom, says lights flickered, cupboards opened on their own: ‘I never stayed alone’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Salman Khan appeared on the couch of Karan Johar ’s Koffee With Karan season 9. During the show, Salman opened up that he had felt a mysterious presence in his bedroom at Galaxy Apartments, where he lived with his family.

Adding to this, Salman Khan says he never lived alone in his room in Galaxy apartment. (PTI) Salman Khan says he felt mysterious presence in his room Karan recalled visiting Salman’s home to pitch Kuch Kuch Hota Hai to him. Remembering his first visit to Galaxy Apartments, Karan shared Salman lived with his family, including his father, Salim Khan, mother, Salma Khan, and brothers Arbaaz and Sohail. He was surprised to see that Salman had a small bedroom with just a cupboard and a bed.

Meanwhile, Salman then recalled, “I never stayed alone in that room. I always stayed there with somebody whom I had never seen, only heard and felt behind me. Every time I came out of that room, the lights flickered. The cupboards used to open on their own; the music system would turn on on its own. Whenever I was in the bathroom, I could feel someone’s presence outside, fidgeting with the cupboards.”

Notably, When Karan asked if he felt the room was haunted, Salman shared, “Not haunted but a presence was felt by me. Whenever I played music, I could feel its presence behind me. So, I used to play music for it and walk out of the room. There was a billiards table outside, and whenever we played there, we could hear that someone was inside the room. It never freaked me out, it didn't do anything. My only request was if you are a really beautiful woman, then show yourself to me.”

As per the latest buzz, Karan further recalled that he had narrated only the first half of Kuch Kuch Hota Hai to Salman, who agreed to do the cameo. The filmmaker also remembered that other people were waiting outside to narrate their films to the star. Salman casually told them, “What a second half he has written”, even though he had not heard the second half of the movie.

In further updates, Kuch Kuch Hota Hai featured Shah Rukh Khan, Rani Mukerji and Kajol in the lead roles, with Salman making a cameo appearance as Aman, Kajol’s fiancé. During Koffee With Karan season 9, Salman also opened up that Saif Ali Khan and Chandrachur Singh, among others, had turned down the role.
On top of that, Salman will next be seen in Maatrubhumi. Directed by Apoorva Lakhia, the movie also stars Chitrangada Singh in a lead role. Its rollout date is yet to be revealed.

Salman also has a project backed by Dil Raju in the pipeline, as per reports titled Monster. Directed by Vamshi Paidipally, the movie will as per reports star Salman and Nayanthara in the lead roles. It is scheduled to rollout in theatres on Eid 2027.

title: Jailer 2 details: All about that superstar's massy cameo, meta references and a homage 40 years after Bhagwaan Dada
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Everyone who just saw the silhouette of Hrithik Roshan in the trailer of Nelson Dilipkumar’s Jailer 2 trailer for a brief 2 seconds and guessed it was him must be patting themselves on their back. Sure, there were rumours circulating about his cameo in the Rajinikanth movie for a while now, but there was a time when even Shah Rukh Khan and Nandamuri Balakrishna’s names did the rounds. As I write this, it’s no surprise that Hrithik does, in fact, get a cameo in Jailer 2 thanks to all the clips circulating on X (formerly Twitter). Know all about the references and homages in his few minutes on screen. *Spoilers ahead*

Adding to this, There’s a point in Jailer 2 when Tiger Muthuvel Pandian (Rajinikanth) is almost painted into a corner, and he requires the help of more than his steadfast friends, Narasimha (Shiva Rajkumar), Mathew (Mohanlal) and Kamdev (Jackie Shroff). When Kamdev warns Muthu that he needs to be careful because Bodhi Kalpak (SJ Suryah) is closing in on him, he makes a phone call, and the new cameo is teased.

Meanwhile, When Muthu’s family is in danger, dressed in a workman jumpsuit, bronzed to the T and rocking a new hairstyle and piercings, Roddy (Hrithik) comes to his aid. Teased almost like Charlie with his angels, he comes to reign chaos with four of his henchwomen (one of whom is played by Bani). Roddy even says that Muthu helped him 20 years ago. “You might have forgotten what you’ve done for me. I’ll never forget. Anytime, anything for you, sir,” he says, kissing his hand.
Notably, The duo then even get a chance to be massy together, with Hrithik paying homage to Rajinikanth’s trademark sunglasses flip as he walks next to him.
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Hrithikrules (Hrithik Roshan) (@hrithikrules_official)

In further updates, Hrithik was only 12 when he shared the screen with Rajinikanth in the 1986 movie Bhagwaan Dada. The movie, which also starred his dad, Rakesh Roshan , saw him play a young boy named Govind, who is adopted by Rajinikanth’s titular character. Jailer 2 marked their reunion after 40 long years, with a now-older Hrithik, seemingly referencing everything Rajinikanth had done for him.

On top of that, In January 2025, even before Jailer 2 went on floors, Hrithik expressed interest in working with Rajinikanth again. At the trailer launch of The Roshans, he shared, “I had no idea that I was standing with the greatest legend of all time. For me, he was Rajni uncle. I used to talk to him like, yeah, no... I had my way with him.” He also added, “I will realise the burden and the weight of the moment that I am sharing screen space with him... He was so gentle and so giving. Whenever I messed up a shot, my grandfather used to cut the shot. And Rajni sir used to take the blame, saying, sorry, sorry, sorry. My fault.”

In August 2025, before Coolie clashed at the ticket-window with his War 2, Hrithik congratulated Rajinikanth on completing 50 years in cinema, writing, “Took my first steps as an star at your side. You were one of my first teachers, @rajinikanth sir, and continue to be an inspiration and a standard. Congratulations on completing 50 years of on-screen magic!”

title: Manoj Bajpayee's 'Ghooskhor Pandat' renamed 'Gajab Raat', to release on Oct 23
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Manoj Bajpayee's 'Ghooskhor Pandat' renamed 'Gajab Raat', to rollout on Oct 23 Directed by Ritesh Shah and produced by Pandey's banner Friday Storytellers, the crime thriller follows a police officer caught between personal gain and doing what he believes is right, as his decision sets off a chain of events over the course of one night, Netflix shared in a press rollout on Thursday.

Adding to this, "My association with Netflix has been an exciting journey, and 'Gajab Raat' is another project I'm delighted to be a part of," Bajpayee, who had also collaborated with the streamer for its 2025 movie "Inspector Zende", shared in a note.

Meanwhile, "I have always been drawn to characters who are not easy to define, and this movie gave me the opportunity to inhabit a world filled with suspense, moral dilemmas and questions of accountability. What makes the story particularly compelling is how the characters' motivations gradually reveal themselves as the night unfolds," he added.
Notably, "Gajab Raat" continues Pandey's creative association with Netflix following the success of "Khakee" franchise, "Sikandar Ka Muqaddar" and the of late-rolled out show "Taskaree".

As per the latest buzz, "I have always believed that an engaging story should do more than keep you guessing; it should also leave you thinking. 'Gajab Raat' is a thriller where the choices that people make push them to a point where there are no easy answers. The tension comes as much from the moral dilemmas the characters face as from the events unfolding over the course of one night," the filmmaker-producer shared.

In further updates, "Reuniting with Manoj and introducing Ritesh as a director was another exciting aspect of the project. I'm looking forward to audiences experiencing the movie on Netflix," he added.
On top of that, Shah, who has worked as a writer on projects such as "Kahaani", "Pink", "Airlift" and "Raid", shared he has been a huge fan of thriller movies.

" pull you into a situation and keep you guessing what happens next, and that was the starting point for 'Gajab Raat'. With the story unfolding over a single night, we had the opportunity to build a sense of urgency and keep raising the stakes as events unfold... I'm looking forward to audiences discovering the movie and experiencing the story for themselves," he shared.

title: Where have Bollywood's children's films vanished? Why the industry that gave Makdee and Taare Zameen Par won't bet on kids anymore
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Movie historians often argue that the 1950s and 60s was the golden age of Indian cinema , when filmmakers experimented with genres, subjects, and socio-political issues freely and without sacrificing mainstream commercial aspirations. The period gave rise to several desi movie genres that remain prevalent today. A similar case could be made for the period between the late 90s and early 2010s for ‘children’s films’ in India. During that 15-17-year period, major filmmakers and stars experimented with mainstream films aimed at children. Be it animation, fantasy, or even coming-of-age, kids were spoilt for choice when it came to Hindi films made for them.

Adding to this, The soon-to-release movie, Little Thomas, is a rarity in these times with a child star in the lead. Around the turn of the millennium, Hindi cinema saw a big, positive change in how films meant for children were mounted, made, and marketed. Mainstream stars, actors, and producers increasingly began to venture into the space. And this continued for over a decade. Vishal Bhardwaj began his career with Makdee and Blue Umbrella. Anurag Kashyap followed Black Friday with Return of Hanuman. Both Yash Raj Films and Dharma Productions backed multiple children’s films. And then there were the non-star-led films that still left their mark, from Stanley Ka Dabba to Jajantaram Mamantaram.

Meanwhile, That is in stark contrast to how the situation is today. The big stars no longer work in children's films. The animation industry has found mythology to be the only gateway for kids, and independent slice-of-life films have diminished in number. So much so that when the trailer of Little Thomas - a movie with an 8-year-old in the lead - dropped, the words used to describe it were ‘rare’ and ‘niche’. What changed, then? Hindustan Times spoke to stakeholders - filmmakers, writers, and producers - who have made such films before to decode where Bollywood’s children’s films vanished.

Notably, The biggest change in the last decade of Indian cinema has been the focus on box-office ‘surety’ as a parameter for making films. ‘Risk averse’ is the term writers and directors use to describe financiers and producers today. Kaushal Oza wrote and directed Little Thomas , an soon-to-release movie about a youngster trying to persuade his parents to give him a sibling. The filmmaker says he had to run pillar to post to pitch the movie before he found a backer. “I wrote this movie and started making it because I liked the story. I didn’t think of it as any particular genre, just an accessible movie that could be low-budget. But when I started putting this out. I realised people are seeing it as a children’s movie because they need a reference point. They shared, ‘Children’s movie kaunsi chalti hai (Which children’s movie is successful).’,” he says.

As per the latest buzz, Movie producer Ranjan Singh, who has backed Little Thomas and began his career with Taare Zameen Par , says the market for children’s films exists, as evidenced by the fact that three of the top 10 highest-grossing films of the year globally are children’s films. He argues, “PVR has a sub-section for kids, with about 80-90 theatres across India dedicated to children. 90% of the films played there throughout the year are Hollywood films, because they know how big a market it is.”

In further updates, Industry insiders say that while Hollywood has created a blueprint for kids’ films to succeed, India has lumped children - as audience members - with adults. The films meant for children are now often those that are meant primarily for their parents or older siblings. Filmmaker Sonam Nair, who made her debut with the heartwarming teen comedy Gippi in 2013, recounts an incident from a recent outing to watch singer Mika Singh perform. “There were two kids who kept dancing, and they kept asking for a song. That was the Pushpa title track. He performed that, and these two kids did the full Pushpa step. That is the change. The kids want to watch Pushpa,” she says.

On top of that, Kaushal Oza echoes this, recalling a conversation he had with writer Jaideep Sahni while he was making Little Thomas. “He shared I was up for a challenge. He shared, ‘Idhar bache Singham dekhte hain, Taarak Mehta dekhte hain (Here, kids watch Singham and Taarak Mehta), which may not even be age-appropriate. Your fight is with these titles’.”

Anurag Kashyap may not be the first name that springs to mind when you talk of children’s films, but for years, he was the director of India’s most successful animated movie. His 2007 movie Return of Hanuman was a cable TV hit, even if it did not do well in theatres. Kashyap attributes the changed scenario to a lack of institutional support. “We had a big advantage earlier because we had the Children’s Movie Commission, which was headed by renowned actors and filmmakers. It was almost mandated for the industry to keep making films that catered to children. That is gone now. The irony is that we live in a time when the administration wants all films to be for children. Even adult films are cut so that they can be watched by children. But they should not be children’s films,” says the filmmaker.

Meanwhile, Gogoi had started the sit-in on October 2, demanding adequate compensation for flood-hit people of Sivasagar, Charaideo, Jorhat and Golaghat districts of Upper Assam.

title: Ghooskhor Pandat renamed Gajab Raat: Trailer of Neeraj Pandey's thriller shows Manoj Bajpayee as cop torn between right and wrong; release date out
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

In February, when Netflix revealed its 2026 slate, one of its projects drew attention for all the wrong reasons. An FIR was filed against the makers of Manoj Bajpayee ’s Ghooskhor Pandat over its title. The movie has now been renamed Gajab Raat, with Netflix releasing its trailer and announcing its rollout date.

Adding to this, Manoj Bajpayee's still from Gajab Raat trailer. Gajab Raat trailer The trailer features Manoj Bajpayee as a police officer torn between personal gain and doing what he believes is right. He is seen investigating a case involving a young girl who is thrown out of a car in a serious condition and later fights for her life in hospital. Unfolding over the course of a single night, the story centres on the officer’s dilemma as he weighs doing the right thing against manipulating the case for his own benefit. One decision could change the course of the investigation and everything that follows. The trailer also offers glimpses of the characters played by Divya Dutta, Nushrratt Bharuccha and Akshay Oberoi.

Meanwhile, In February, after Netflix revealed Ghooskhor Pandat (now titled Gajab Raat), the name became the subject of widespread criticism. The row centred on the combination of the words ‘Ghooskhor’, meaning someone who takes bribes, and ‘Pandat’, a colloquial spelling of ‘Pandit’, a term associated with Brahmins and religious scholars. Several people objected to the title, arguing that it linked the Brahmin community with corruption. They alleged that it was derogatory, promoted caste-based stereotyping and hurt the sentiments of the religious community.

Notably, The backlash prompted the makers to withdraw the promotional material and agree to rename the project. The matter eventually reached the courts. Amid the criticism, director Neeraj Pandey issued a statement acknowledging that the title had hurt some viewers. He maintained that the project was a fictional cop drama and that ‘Pandat’ was intended as the colloquial name of a fictional character, rather than a reference to any particular community. He added that the story focused on an individual’s actions and choices and did not comment on or represent any caste, religion or community.

As per the latest buzz, The row took a legal turn when the Uttar Pradesh government ordered an FIR against the movie’s makers over the disputed title. An FIR was registered at Lucknow’s Hazratganj police station amid allegations that the title hurt caste and religious sentiments. The Federation of Western India Cine Employees (FWICE) also objected to the title, arguing that provocative movie titles could hurt sentiments and create social discord. Petitions seeking to prevent the movie’s rollout were subsequently filed in the Delhi High Court.

In further updates, On February 10, 2026, Netflix informed the Delhi High Court that the producer had consciously decided to change the title in light of the concerns raised. The court subsequently disposed of the petition after the petitioner indicated that the grievance had been addressed.

On top of that, The matter also reached the Supreme Court. On February 12, 2026, a bench comprising Justices BV Nagarathna and Ujjal Bhuyan questioned the makers over the title and directed them to confirm its withdrawal and provide details of the replacement name. The court made it clear that it would not permit the movie’s rollout unless the title was changed.

On February 19, 2026, the Supreme Court disposed of the petition after Neeraj Pandey submitted an affidavit confirming that the original title had been withdrawn. He also undertook that the new title, once finalised, would neither resemble nor evoke the earlier name and would accurately reflect the movie’s narrative and intent.

title: JNU students enter day 12 of indefinite hunger strike over rustication of JNUSU members, demand restoration of GSCASH and JNUEE
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

New Delhi: Jawaharlal Nehru University Students Union (JNUSU) Vice President K Gopika Babu along with office-bearers and students during an indefinite hunger strike in New Delhi, Wednesday, Oct. 14, 2026. (PTI Photo/Rushikesh More) JNUSU president Aditi Mishra, vice-president K. Gopika Babu and general secretary Sunil Yadav along with several other students have been sitting on an indefinite hunger strike for the past 12 days.

Adding to this, The students declared the strike with a charter of 13 demands including rolling back Chief Proctor Office (CPO) Manual, revoking rustication of JNUSU office bearers, reinstating Gender Sensitisation Committee Against Sexual Harassment (GSCASH) and JNU entrance exam JNUEE, among others.

Meanwhile, As per a JNUSU press rollout dated October 3, the students are seeking the “immediate resolution of a series of longstanding academic, infrastructural, social justice, welfare and democratic concerns affecting students across the university.”

Notably, As per reports, on October 12, after 9 days of the strike, the administration initiated a second round of negotiations. A discussion took place between the JNUSU office bearers, councillors, associate deans Dr Poonguzhali N and Jaikhlong Basumatary, dean of students, and the dean of School of Social Sciences (SSS).

As per the latest buzz, According to the union, the administration shared that it would look into the matter of CPO manual but gave no comprehensive response on the rustication of students, restoration of GSCASH. On the issue of JNUEE, it cited lack of funding as the main obstacle.

In further updates, The administration also agreed to look into the union's allegations that reservation laws are being violated in hostel allotment. “Reverse reservation is going on”, K. Gopika Babu shared in a video shared by the union.

On top of that, The students, however, are continuing their strike. In a statement rolled out after the negotiation, the union shared, “The outcome of the second round of negotiations makes it clear that the administration is still unwilling to offer concrete commitments on our legitimate demands. Mere assurances, promises to seek legal opinions and prepare feasibility reports cannot substitute for action.”

Additionally, in a notice issued on October 9, the university has asked JNUSU president and PhD student Aditi Mishra to appear before a proctorial committee on October 22 over allegations of manhandling security personnel and damaging campus property during a September 8 protest.

title: Nana Patekar once demanded ₹1 more than Amitabh Bachchan to work with him, says Drishyam 3 actor Kamlesh Sawant
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Veteran star Nana Patekar died at the age of 75 after suffering a cardiac arrest at his residence in Goa. Several Bollywood stars, including Shah Rukh Khan and Amitabh Bachchan , paid tribute to the star on social media. Now, star Kamlesh Sawant has reflected on Nana's legacy and the grief surrounding his death.

Adding to this, Amitabh Bachchan and Nana Patekar's still from Kohram. Kamlesh Sawant recalls Nana Patekar's condition to work with Amitabh Bachchan In an interview with Pinkvilla, Kamlesh recalled hearing that Nana Patekar had made a unique demand to work with Amitabh Bachchan in a movie. He shared, "I did work with him in a movie, but unfortunately, I didn’t have any scenes with him. I regret that sometimes. We have seen him working and have also heard multiple stories about him. This one time, I heard that he demanded ₹ 1 more than Amitabh Bachchan’s fees to work with him in a movie. He shared, ‘Bachchan sahab ke saath main kaam karunga toh ₹ 1 zyada lunga (If I work with Bachchan sir, I will take ₹ 1 more).’ Then he took ₹ 1 crore rupees and ₹ 1 for a movie, while Amitabh Bachchan was paid ₹ 1 crore rupees. This is what I have heard, but I am not sure how true it is."
Meanwhile, Big B and Nana Patekar worked together in the movie Kohram (1999), directed by Mehul Kumar. It was the only movie in which the two actors shared screen space.

Notably, Kamlesh also reflected on the legacy Nana left behind, explaining how he helped shift the focus in Hindi cinema towards dialogue delivery. He shared, "There was a time when Bollywood would completely work on music and dance, but eventually, the focus shifted to dialogues. That era was started by Nana Patekar. People would clap at all of his dialogues. I have first-hand experienced the craze around his dialogues at Ganesh Talkies and Jai Hind Talkies. People would watch his films multiple times. They would go crazy hearing him deliver dialogues. This was Nana Patekar's strength."

As per the latest buzz, Kamlesh further recalled that Nana was among the few actors who could command complete silence in single-screen theatres, alongside Amitabh Bachchan. He shared audiences would watch Nana's films multiple times and knew exactly when to fall silent to listen to his dialogues, often anticipating each line and waiting for the next one.

In further updates, Nana died at his residence in Goa after suffering a cardiac arrest. He was taken to hospital, where doctors attempted cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) for 45 minutes, but they were unable to revive him.

On top of that, The post-mortem report opened up that the star had suffered a heart attack caused by a blood clot blocking the left main coronary artery, which supplies blood to a large part of the heart. The report cited the cause of death as acute myocardial infarction due to left main coronary artery thrombosis secondary to atherosclerotic occlusive coronary artery disease, describing it as a natural cause of death. The star is survived by his wife, Neelakanti Patekar, and son, Malhar Patekar.

title: Why Imran Khan was asked to leave India after anti-CEC protests and what BJP's Kirit Somaiya said
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Star Imran Khan's participation in a Mumbai protest seeking chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation has landed him in an immigration row, with authorities directing him to leave the country by October 28 .

Adding to this, Star Imran Khan was among hundreds of people detained by Mumbai Police on October 10 (HT photo) The development follows a complaint by BJP leader Kirit Somaiya, who questioned the star's involvement in the demonstration despite his status as a foreign national.

Meanwhile, The Mumbai office of the Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO) served the notice on Khan, an American citizen registered as an Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) cardholder. Somaiya had approached the police over the star's presence at the October 10 gathering at August Kranti Maidan, prompting the complaint to be referred to the immigration authorities.

Notably, The episode has brought renewed attention to the restrictions governing OCI cardholders and their participation in political activities in India. While the status allows eligible foreign citizens of Indian origin several residency and travel-related privileges, it does not confer Indian citizenship. The action against Khan has also raised questions about the legal grounds on which an OCI cardholder can be directed to leave the country.

As per the latest buzz, Imran Khan was among hundreds of people detained by Mumbai Police on October 10 during a demonstration organised in support of the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP). The protesters were demanding Kumar's resignation over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.

In further updates, The gathering at August Kranti Maidan was called by Tushar Gandhi, Mahatma Gandhi's great-grandson, to express solidarity with the CJP's protest in Delhi. Police had deployed heavy security around the venue and detained demonstrators who attempted to reach the site.

On top of that, Mumbai Police shared permission had not been obtained for the proposed gathering. The force also cited Bombay High Court directions restricting protests to Azad Maidan. CJP workers, however, maintained that they had emailed the police seeking permission but had received no response.
Khan's detention drew attention after he posted a selfie from inside a police van on Instagram with the caption, “Apparently I'm going for a drive.”

title: US singer Mary Millben, CJP's Abhijeet Dipke trade barbs over 'foreign funding' amid anti-CEC protests in Delhi
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

As the protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar continue in India, Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke found himself in a social media row with American singer Mary Millben.

Adding to this, The American Singer hit out at Dipke and the pressure group on Wednesday, alleging that the CJP was "funded by donors to the US" who are against Prime Minister Narendra Modi. (ANI) The American singer hit out at Dipke and the pressure group on Wednesday, alleging that the CJP was "funded by donors to the US" who are against Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Track LIVE updates on Delhi protest here

Meanwhile, "Do not fear, my young patriots. Your Prime Minister, who has served India for 25 years, 12 years as Prime Minister, elected three consecutive terms, is not going to bow to disruptive forces from my country. And these select donors have a pattern globally - target conservative global leaders, find an U.S. educated person from the country, radicalize them, send them back to the country, and fund them to start chaos and destruction. None of them have been successful but have impacted the development and governance of the country," the singer wrote on X.

Notably, "It is time for a new voice in #India, born, raised, educated on the soil of India, to RISE UP, organise, and peacefully protest the disruptive spirit of the Cockroach Party... Rise up, young patriots! Rise up!," she added.
As per the latest buzz, Responding to Millben, Dipke took to X and asked: "Who gave foreign nationals the right to interfere in India's internal affairs?"

In further updates, "Why is Modi seeking the support of Americans to discredit his own countrymen? Who gave foreign nationals the right to interfere in India’s internal affairs? We are more than capable of dealing with our own issues. We don’t need outsiders interfering in our country’s affairs," the CJP founder wrote.
On top of that, The American singer, however, did not back down and hit out at Dipke yet again.

"The truth sets everybody free. Even you. And here’s the truth: these US donors will drop you like a hot cake when you don’t succeed. And you won’t, because lawlessness never wins. Instead, take your U.S. education, talent, and use it for good. Sit down with PM Modi and be a positive voice to advance India. The truth of your courage to do what’s right lies in your next steps," the singer wrote.

title: Actor Imran Khan asked to leave India by October 28 after he took part in anti-CEC protests in Mumbai
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The Foreigners Regional Registration Office (FRRO) in Mumbai has asked star Imran Khan, who was claimed to be an American citizen, to leave India by October 28.

Adding to this, Imran Khan was detained by the Mumbai Police on October 10 for participating in the anti-CEC protests in Mumbai. (HT Photo/Raju Shinde) The move came after Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leader Kirit Somaiya complained that the star, despite having a US passport and Overseas Citizen of India (OCI), had participated in Cockroach Janta Party (CJP)'s protest against chief election commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar at the August Kranti Maidan in Mumbai Central on October 10.

Meanwhile, "The FRRO has taken the action and a notice was served to the star Imran Khan, who is [in India] on an OCI card. The star nephew of Bollywood star Amir Khan stays in Khar and was served the notice," shared a Mumbai Police official.

Notably, FRRO is the agency responsible for regulating the registration, movement, stay, departure, and visa extensions of foreign nationals. It operates under the Bureau of Immigration, Ministry of Home Affairs. It operates in close coordination with and through the police infrastructure.
As per the latest buzz, BJP leader Somaiya urged Mumbai Police to verify Khan’s citizenship and questioned whether a foreign national should be taking part in a political agitation.

In further updates, The star was born and educated in the US, but collected his livelihood in India while "participating in political and diplomatic activities opposing the government," he shared, according to news agency PTI.
On top of that, "I had sought a report on how long Imran Khan had been a US citizen," Somaiya shared, adding that he was grateful to the authorities for taking action.

At the protests, Imran Khan shared he was not present at the protests with any specific demands, but had come forward in his capacity as "a citizen". He shared he wanted to understand why freedom of movement was being restricted and why people’s voices were being suppressed.

title: Punjab bandh LIVE: Roads, tolls blocked, markets shut across state; protesters detained in Moga, Amritsar
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Protestors who refused to cooperate with the police were detained in Amritsar, Patiala and Moga Chowk. Punjab bandh LIVE updates: Punjab chief minister Bhagwant Mann on Wednesday vowed the strictest punishment for those involved in the murder of anti-drug activist Parvinder Singh Jhota, as outrage over the daylight killing spilled into a second day and tensions remained high in Mansa town. Jhota's father, Bhim Singh, launched a scathing attack on the administration and called for a Punjab Bandh on October 15. The demand received support from opposition parties, farmer unions and the Shiromani Gurdwara Parbandhak Committee (SGPC). ...Read More

Adding to this, Hours after Jhota was shot dead in Mansa, the police on Wednesday arrested the accused, a pharmacy owner, Ashwani Kumar, from Rajasthan even as anger against the killing spilled onto the streets, with mob setting the chemist’s shop ablaze and authorities razing a portion of his house. Jhota’s father gave a Punjab bandh call on Thursday with political parties, including the Congress, Akali Dal, BJP, Akali Dal Waris Punjab De, and farmers’ body Samyukta Kisan Morcha and other farmers’ unions and state government employees’ unions extending support to it. The family has also refused to cremate the body.

Meanwhile, Punjab Bandh LIVE: Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta on Thursday criticised the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) and Congress, accusing them of focusing on her, rather than highlighting the work being done by her government.

Notably, Taking aim at the opposition, Gupta also raised concerns over Punjab’s law and order situation, alleging that murders were taking place in broad daylight, people were dying by suicide and the drug mafia remained active in the state. She accused the opposition parties of remaining silent on these issues.
As per the latest buzz, "Murders are happening in broad daylight in Punjab. People are dying by suicide. The drug mafia is active there. But they do not speak on it," Gupta shared.

In further updates, Punjab Bandh LIVE: Police detained protesters in Patiala for allegedly forcing shopkeepers to shut their establishments during the Punjab bandh called over the murder of anti-drug activist Parvinder Singh Jhota.

On top of that, Punjab Bandh LIVE: On the Punjab bandh call, Border Range IG Gurpreet Singh Bhullar shared around 1,300 police personnel have been deployed across the border range, covering Pathankot, Gurdaspur, Batala and Amritsar Rural. He added that senior officers, including SSPs, were personally overseeing security arrangements, while striking reserves and mobile units remained on standby.

Speaking about the situation at the toll plaza on the GT Road, which connects to the national highway leading towards Delhi, Bhullar shared traffic was moving normally and the situation remained peaceful. He added that police had taken action wherever necessary and “no one has been permitted to take the law into their own hands”.

title: Rahul Gandhi's visit, crackdown, hunger strike threat: Inside a long night at India Gate during protest by Ankita Bhandari's parents
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

A police crackdown before dawn at India Gate in Delhi on Thursday brought a sit-in protest by the parents of Ankita Bhandari , who was murdered in Uttarakhand’s Pauri Garhwal district in September 2022, to an end after they were briefly detained.

Adding to this, Police personnel detain the mother of 19-year-old Ankita Bhandari, who was murdered in Uttarakhand in 2022, while protesting near India Gate against Dushyant Kumar Gautam's appointment as Sikkim governor, in New Delhi. (@INCIndia/X) Leader of the Opposition (LoP) in the Lok Sabha and Congress MP Rahul Gandhi had joined the protest the previous evening, along with several party leaders and workers. The protest opposed the appointment of former Uttarakhand BJP in-charge Dushyant Kumar Gautam as the Governor of Sikkim.

Meanwhile, Notably, the parents have demanded that Gautam’s appointment be put on hold until the ongoing Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) probe into the alleged VIP angle in the case is completed.

Notably, After Gandhi left, Congress leaders and workers continued the protest, raising slogans. Police moved in before dawn, briefly detained Ankita’s parents and removed the party workers from the site.
As per the latest buzz, Rahul Gandhi arrived with his sister, Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, and other Congress leaders to express support for Ankita’s parents.

In further updates, Gandhi’s visit marked his return to the streets of Delhi, albeit for a different cause. title: Karisma Kapoor reveals Salman Khan refused to shoot with her over her ‘too open, clingy’ outfit in Dulhan Hum Le Jayenge
body: Here's the latest fashion moment turning heads:

Karan Johar has returned with the ninth and final season of Koffee With Karan , with Salman Khan as the first guest to grace the iconic couch. During the conversation, Karisma recalled how the two would get into arguments on the movie's sets, revealing that Salman once refused to shoot with her because of her outfit.

Adding to this, Salman Khan objected to Karisma Kapoor's outfit in Dulhan Hum Le Jayenge. Salman Khan objected to Karisma Kapoor's outfit during Dulhan Hum Le Jayenge shoot Karisma opened up that Salman has a sweet tooth and recalled having chocolates with him at breakfast during the shoot of one of their films. She then opened up that they used to fight a lot too. Karisma revealed, "During Dulhan Hum Le Jayenge, the iconic outfit, I was very excited about my fashion, and I thought I was going to kill it, and he's like, 'What are you wearing? I will not give a shot with you looking like this.'"

Meanwhile, Karisma opened up that she had to go and complain to David Dhawan that Salman was not letting her wear the outfit. When Karan asked if Salman had an issue because of the outfit being overtly sexy, Karisma admitted and shared, "Yaa because the outfit was too open and too clingy." Salman then denied it and depicted that the outfit was too short and added, "I used to keep on asking her to get it down before every take. It was all sheer."
Notably, Karisma admitted that Salman was too protective about her, adding, "He would say, 'Go and change it, I don't like this outfit.' So we used to fight a lot."

As per the latest buzz, Dulhan Hum Le Jayenge is a 2000 romantic comedy starring Salman Khan and Karisma Kapoor. When Raja decides to marry Sapna, he must win over all three uncles, each of whom has a different idea of the ideal husband for her. The movie also stars Paresh Rawal, Om Puri and Anupam Kher as Sapna's uncles. The movie's music and Salman-Karisma's chemistry contributed to its popularity. The movie was among the commercially successful Hindi releases of 2000.

In further updates, Salman and Karisma were one of Bollywood's popular on-screen pairs in the 1990s and early 2000s, known for their chemistry in romantic comedies, family dramas and action films. The duo starred together in 11 films such as Judwaa (1997), Biwi No. 1 (1999), and Chal Mere Bhai (2000). title: Drishyam 3 actor Ishita Dutta says Deepika Padukone's 8-hour shift demand is not unreasonable: ‘You need to have a baby to realise it’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

In 2025, Deepika Padukone 's exit from Sandeep Reddy Vanga's Spirit and Nag Ashwin's Kalki 2898 AD sequel sparked a debate about shorter working hours for actors on set. Several actors backed Deepika's demand for eight-hour shifts, and now Drishyam 3 star Ishita Dutta has also weighed in, saying producers should not belittle actors for making such requests.

Adding to this, Ishita Dutta backs Deepika Padukone's 8-hour shift demand. Ishita Dutta backs Deepika Padukone's 8-hour shift demand In an interview with Free Press Journal, Ishita shared she does not believe an eight-hour shift is an unreasonable demand. She pointed out that several male actors are neither mothers nor willing to work for 12–15 hours a day. She shared, "I'm saying giving it or not (8 hour shift) is your personal choice, so production can say no but making a big deal about it and trying to not justify it that is where the problem lies. There are a lot of actors who you can take, who are willing to work for 12-15 hours. But you can not belittle the other person by saying that this is unreasonable ask."

Meanwhile, Ishita, who is a mother to two kids, also opened up that she had worked longer hours herself, but the makers had been considerate enough to let her leave early. She added, "You need to have a baby to realise how much of it goes. If you have the place where you can demand, I would also probably demand. I don't think I'm there yet."

title: How an anime skull became Gen Z's protest symbol: What Neha Bora's red T-shirt means
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

A red T-shirt worn by student activist Neha Bora during a Delhi protest has gone widely shared for its skull-and-crossbones symbol from One Piece, a Japanese manga and anime series whose pirate flag has become a symbol of youth-led protests across the world.

Adding to this, All India Students' Association (AISA) National President Neha Bora, advocate Prashant Bhushan, activist Yogendra Yadav, and CPI(ML) Liberation General Secretary Dipankar Bhattacharya lead a march near INA Market towards Jantar Mantar on October 10 (@_YogendraYadav on X) Bora, national president of the All India Students’ Association (AISA), wore the T-shirt during the October 10 protests over the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls and demands for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation. Protesters alleged irregularities in the revision process.

Meanwhile, The flag belongs to the Straw Hat Pirates, a fictional crew led by Monkey D. Luffy, whose adventures revolve around freedom, friendship and challenging powerful, oppressive rulers. Protesters, especially from Gen Z (born between 1997 and 2012), in countries such as Indonesia, Nepal and the Philippines have adopted the emblem to express resistance to authority and anger over corruption.

Notably, Created by Japanese manga artist Eiichiro Oda, One Piece began publication in 1997. It follows Luffy and his crew as they search for a legendary treasure called the One Piece. Luffy wants to become the Pirate King, but the story is also about his crew’s battles against powerful figures who exploit ordinary people.

As per the latest buzz, The series has sold more than 500 million copies worldwide. Its themes of freedom, loyalty and standing up to injustice have helped it develop a global following, extending from manga readers to viewers of its anime and live-action adaptations.
In further updates, The symbol on Bora’s T-shirt is the Straw Hat Pirates’ Jolly Roger, a pirate flag featuring a grinning skull wearing Luffy’s signature straw hat, with crossed bones behind it.

On top of that, Within the story, the flag represents the crew’s identity and its commitment to freedom. Luffy and his companions repeatedly challenge the World Government, a powerful institution depicted as corrupt and oppressive, and help communities facing exploitation.
That association has given the emblem a meaning beyond anime fandom. For protesters, it can represent resistance to powerful institutions and solidarity among people demanding change.

title: Delhi protest LIVE: Dipke urges political parties, youth, farmer unions, student bodies to join ‘Tiranga March’ tomorrow
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Abhijeet Dipke, Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) Founder and National Convenor, along with Neha Bora (AISA) , Prakash Raj, Star and Activist during a press conference at Press Club of India. SC Delhi protest hearing LIVE: Amid tensions in the national capital, the Supreme Court on Thursday heard a series of petitions concerning the Opposition’s challenge to the Election Commission’s Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise and alleged police excesses, mass detentions and harassment of journalists and lawyers during anti-CEC protests in Delhi last week. ...Read More

Adding to this, Key takeaways from the Supreme Court hearing: SIR challenge: Notices issued on petitions challenging the Election Commission’s Special Intensive Revision exercise. Jantar Mantar: Government asked to clarify the decision to denotify the designated protest site. Journalists’ safety: Court termed molestation allegations against police “very serious” and considered a committee headed by a retired woman judge. Protection from coercive action: Relief granted to a woman journalist booked under the SC/ST Act. Preservation of evidence: Court directed authorities to preserve CCTV footage and other digital material. Alleged police excesses against lawyers: Notices issued on petitions alleging assaults and illegal detention of lawyers. CJP's press conference CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke on Thursday hit out at Prime Minister Narendra Modi, accusing him of bringing Delhi to a standstill to “protect” Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Addressing a press conference, he claimed that railway and Metro services had been shut down and Delhi had been turned into a “India-Pakistan border.” Furthermore, Dipke on Wednesday called for a ‘Tiranga March’ at Connaught Place's Central Park on Friday. The march comes in response to the jailing of co-convenors Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka. Ahead of the march, Delhi Police informed the Delhi High Court that all possible measures under the law would be taken against the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP)’s call for supporters to gather with the national flag at Central Park on Friday. Anti-CEC protests in Delhi | Key developments - CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke has called for a Tiranga march in Connaught Place's Central Park. Dipke's call comes after his co-convenors Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were remanded to five-days judicial custody in Delhi's Tihar Jail. -Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka, co-convenors of the CJP, were jailed on Wednesday after their “preventive arrest.” The duo, along with 12 other CJP leaders, were detained on Tuesday morning after they breached Jantar Mantar and unfurled the tricolour, days after the site was de-notified as a protest venue. -Produced before a special executive magistrate on Wednesday morning, cops shared that they have a presumption that Das and Ranka “may commit a crime” if they are let go, leading to their preventive arrest and judicial custody. -Congress MP and Lok Sabha Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi also showed support for CJP and condemned the jailing of Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka. Several other Opposition leaders also backed the pressure group. -Mumbai police has also issued a notice to Bollywood star Imran Khan, asking him to leave India by October 28 over his participation in the anti-CEC stir in Maharashtra.

Meanwhile, Delhi protest LIVE: The government on Thursday clarified that the Union Home Secretary’s affidavit before the Supreme Court, in response to a contempt notice, should not be interpreted as an unconditional apology.
Notably, It shared that beginning the affidavit with an unconditional apology is a mandatory practice in contempt proceedings, followed by the presentation of facts and arguments.

As per the latest buzz, "Some media organisations report that the Union Home Secretary has tendered an unconditional apology to the Honourable Supreme Court in response to a contempt notice. In this regard, this is to state:

In further updates, Whenever a contempt notice is issued by the Honourable Supreme Court, it is required that the party responding to the notice must begin their affidavit with an unconditional apology. Only thereafter all other facts and arguments are presented. This is mandatorily followed in every contempt petition."

On top of that, The government added that the affidavits filed by the Home Secretary, Delhi Police Commissioner and other officials followed this procedure and maintained that all actions taken by the government and police were lawful, with no case of contempt made out.
Delhi protest LIVE: Chaos erupted during a press conference addressed by AISA president Neha Bora and CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke at the Press Club of India on Thursday.

title: Ankita Bhandari's parents briefly detained during protest at Delhi's India Gate, mother threatens hunger strike
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The parents of Ankita Bhandari were detained on Thursday during their sit-in protest at India Gate in Delhi against the appointment of former Uttarakhand BJP in-charge Dushyant Kumar Gautam as the Governor of Sikkim. They were rolled out later.

Adding to this, Lok Sabha LoP Rahul Gandhi and Congress MP Priyanka Gandhi Vadra meet the parents of Ankita Bhandari, protesting against the appointment of BJP leader Dushyant Kumar Gautam as Sikkim Governor. (ANI) The parents of the 19-year-old receptionist, who was murdered in Uttarakhand’s Pauri Garhwal district in September 2022, have demanded that Gautam’s appointment be put on hold until the ongoing Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) probe into the alleged VIP angle in the case is completed.
Meanwhile, On Wednesday evening, Lok Sabha LoP Rahul Gandhi and Congress MP Priyanka Gandhi met the parents near India Gate and joined them during their sit-in protest.

Notably, Visuals shared by news agency ANI showed police taking Bhandari’s mother into custody. After being detained, she shared she would begin a hunger strike at their home if the authorities did not allow them to protest.

As per the latest buzz, "We want to state that we will remain steadfast until his (Dushyant Gautam) appointment is revoked... If we are not permitted to sit here, we will sit on a hunger strike in our own homes," she shared.

In further updates, Her father shared, “We give the government a 24-hour ultimatum: the appointment of Dushyant Kumar as the Governor of Sikkim must be cancelled. If it is not revoked, the people across the entire country will take to the streets, and the government will be held responsible.”

On top of that, Activist Yogita Bhayana also joined the protest, where Ankita’s parents appealed to President Droupadi Murmu to intervene and ensure that all allegations related to the case were investigated.

Expressing support for the parents, Rahul Gandhi accused the BJP of protecting a “VIP” accused in the case. In a post on X, he shared the family had been waiting for justice for four years, alleging that the accused had instead received protection and a constitutional post. “I and the Congress Party stand with them — in their grief as well as in this fight for justice,” he shared.

title: CJP, Congress push to restore protests at Jantar Mantar amid arrest of leaders
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The of late decommissioned protest site of Jantar Mantar brought the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) and the broader Opposition on the same page on Wednesday after three CJP members were jailed, triggering condemnation and a vow to restore the 18th-century observatory’s status as the Capital’s agitation hub.

Adding to this, Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke along with party activists pose with the national tricolour following their rollout after being detained by Delhi Police near Jantar Mantar. (@abhijeet_dipke) Special executive magistrate Mahesh Kumar Meena remanded CJP leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka to five days’ judicial custody for allegedly trespassing into a private property to reach Jantar Mantar and violating bonds requiring them to maintain peace.

Meanwhile, “The past conduct of both accused persons shows that they violated the lawful directions of the authorities. The present conduct of both accused persons shows that they are likely to breach peace and tranquillity in the area,” shared the magistrate’s order.

Notably, The controversial decision came a day after Das, Ranka and Ajinkya Shinde breached barricades, snuck into Jantar Mantar – no longer a designated protest site, after an order earlier this week – and raised the Tricolour, while shouting slogans against chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
As per the latest buzz, Das and Ranka are among 11 people booked by the Delhi Police for entering Jantar Mantar by trespassing through a private premise.

In further updates, An FIR in connection with the incident has been lodged at Connaught Police Station under sections 223A (knowing disobedience of a lawful order issued by a public servant), 332 (house-trespass in order to commit an offence) and 61(2) (criminal conspiracy) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, while another FIR under BNS sections 221 (voluntarily obstructing public servant in the discharge of their public functions), 115(2) (voluntarily causing simple hurt to another person), 132 (assault or criminal force used to deter a public servant from discharging their duty), and other sections, was lodged at Parliament Street Police Station.

On top of that, “From the material on record, it is imperative that the above-shared respondents, after having executed a bond/bail bond for keeping the peace in pursuance of an order of SEM South West under Section 136 BNSS, have again committed breach of the bond/bail bond, which is evident from their conduct/social media posts and statement of complainant,” the order read.

Shinde was rolled out on a personal bond and a surety of ₹ 5,000. The other two –– who were previously detained from a flight on October 11 and rolled out after signing a bond –– were sent to Tihar jail .

title: ‘Biopic of my life will never be made’: Salman Khan says the stories about his life will go with him to the grave on Koffee With Karan season 9
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Salman Khan was in a fun mood as he arrived on Koffee With Karan season 9, hosted by Karan Johar . The star spoke about his desire to have children, talked about his recent schooling of paparazzi, and then caught up with Karisma Kapoor for the Rapid Fire round. Karisma asked him a question about who will he pick to direct his biopic if one were ever made. The options were Sooraj Barjatya, Kabir Khan, Sanjay Leela Bhansali and David Dhawan. Salman had the perfect response to the fun question.

Adding to this, Koffee With Karan Season 9: Salman Khan kicked off Karan Johar’s final season with unfiltered banter. Salman's response Explaining his choices, the star shared, “Depending, if you want to make a comedy on my life then David Dhawan. If you want to make traditional tragic love story, then would be Sanjay Leela Bhansali. If you want to make this beautiful love story after love story after love story, it would be Sooraj Barjatya.” He then shared that Kabir Khan would be perfect if it were to be an action-packed love story on his life.
Meanwhile, However, he had the last word on the subject as he added, "But, a biopic of my life will never be made. My life will go to my grave.”

Notably, Meanwhile, Karan also made sure to ask Salman: ‘Are you still a virgin?’ Salman laughed at this and shared that he had made that statement in a way of saying that he does not want to talk about his dating life or his relationships. “Because you keep on saying, ‘You are dating so-and-so’… and you never know that this is the person who is going to be in your life for the rest of your life. And then that person goes ahead and gets married to somebody else. I always had this from the time I was 15-16,” he shared.

As per the latest buzz, He added that it was his father, Salim Khan , who had advised him to keep his bedroom talk within the bedroom and not bring it to the living room. title: Drishyam 3 box office collection day 13: Ajay Devgn film slows down ahead of Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 release, crosses ₹327 crore
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Drishyam 3 ticket-window earnings day 13 : Ajay Devgn ’s crime thriller has crossed the ₹ 300 crore rupees mark, emerging as the highest-grossing movie of his career. Now that Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 is gearing up for a nationwide rollout tomorrow, the buzz for Drishyam 3 stands significantly low midweek. Let's take a look at the ticket-window performance of Drishyam 3 so far.

Adding to this, Drishyam 3 ticket-window earnings day 13: A still from Drishyam 3 with Ajay Devgn and Jaideep Ahlawat. Drishyam 3 dips midweek For Ajay Devgn, Drishyam 3 registered the biggest opening of his career. The advance bookings for Drishyam The Conclusion opened on September 27, and the movie went on to collect ₹ 27 crore rupees before its rollout. By the end of the day, the movie went on to collect ₹ 66.75 crore rupees net across India. This is the third biggest opening by a Hindi movie ever and the biggest in Ajay Devgn’s career. On the first Saturday, the movie collected ₹ 53.50 crore rupees, and showed huge growth on Sunday, bringing in ₹ 61 crore rupees. It is the highest single-day haul of the movie so far.

Meanwhile, The first dip started on Monday, when the movie collected ₹ 21 crore rupees, around 65.6% lower than its Sunday figure. The decline continued on Tuesday, when Drishyam 3 collected ₹ 19.50 crore rupees, and on Wednesday with ₹ 15.50 crore rupees. The movie drew an end to its first week at ₹ 245.50 crore rupees. The movie crossed the ₹ 300 crore rupees mark within ten days of rollout. As per the latest update on Sacnilk, Drishyam 3 collected ₹ 4.46 crore rupees on its second Wednesday in theatres. It is the lowest single-day haul for the movie so far. This brings the total ticket-window earnings for the movie to ₹ 327.96 crore rupees .

Notably, Drishyam 3 will face significant heat from Rajinikanth 's big rollout Jailer 2. The sequel is one of the most anticipated films of the year, and is set for a massive splash at the ticket-window, aiming to earn a staggering ₹ 140 crore rupees on its rollout day itself. By the morning of October 14 (Wednesday), the movie's advance bookings had crossed ₹ 80 crore rupees worldwide for its opening weekend.

As per the latest buzz, Drishyam 3 brings back Ajay Devgn’s Vijay Salgaonkar, along with Tabu, Shriya Saran, Rajat Kapoor, Ishita Dutta, Mrunal Jadhav, and Kamlesh Sawant. Saurabh Shukla also reprises his role from the second part in a cameo.

In further updates, Drishyam The Conclusion is backed by Star Studio18 and Panorama Studios, with Abhishek Pathak returning to direct the third instalment. He has also co-written the movie with Aamil Keeyan Khan and Parveez Shaikh. Alok Jain, Ajit Andhare, Kumar Mangat Pathak and Abhishek Pathak are producing the movie.

title: Salman Khan calls Ranveer Singh ‘secure actor’, explains why his Dhurandhar performance cannot be compared with Ranbir Kapoor’s Animal
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

On the final season of Koffee With Karan , Salman Khan became the first guest of the season where Karan Johar talked about everything from his career to his health and beyond. During the conversation, Salman has shared why he would not compare Ranveer Singh ’s performance in Dhurandhar and Dhurandhar: The Revenge with Ranbir Kapoor ’s in Animal. During the premiere episode of Season 9, the star was asked to choose the more impactful performance between the two films. Instead of picking a winner, Salman explained how both actors brought different strengths to their roles.

Adding to this, Salman Khan was all praises for Ranveer Singh and his performance in Dhurandhar and explained why his work can't be compared to Ranbir Kapoor's Animal. Salman Khan on Ranveer Singh and Ranbir Kapoor’s performances During the rapid-fire segment, Karisma Kapoor made a special appearance to ask questions to Salman and host Karan Johar. She asked Salman which performance had made a greater impact, Ranbir Kapoor in Animal or Ranveer Singh in Dhurandhar.

Meanwhile, Salman refused to choose between the two, explaining that their performances were different in nature. He shared, “Two different kinds of performance. You cannot compare any of them.” When Karisma suggested that he was being diplomatic, Salman clarified that he genuinely felt both actors deserved equal appreciation.

Notably, He went onto say, “It is not diplomatic at all. Both are fantastic actors. One has got tremendous amount of energy. One has got tremendous amount of intensity. Both have different styles of acting.”

As per the latest buzz, Salman went on to explain what impressed him about Ranveer’s performance in Dhurandhar. The star is known for his energetic performances and larger-than-life screen presence, but Salman pointed out that the role required him to hold back rather than go all out. He felt that this restraint showed how comfortable Ranveer was with his character.

In further updates, He added, “Especially for Ranveer in Dhurandhar, he had to control all his energy. He does everything larger than life and he had to control that big time. For an star, that’s a huge amount of insecurity that he did not have it in the movie. He is very secure as an star and in that role in Dhurandhar.”
On top of that, Karan agreed with Salman’s assessment, responding, “Correct, well shared.”

Directed by Sandeep Reddy Vanga , Animal was rolled out in theatres on December 1, 2023. The movie follows Ranvijay Singh, played by Ranbir, whose complicated relationship with his father, Balbir Singh (Anil Kapoor), shapes much of his life. When his father comes under attack, Ranvijay returns home and sets out on a violent mission for revenge. The movie also stars Rashmika Mandanna, Bobby Deol and Triptii Dimri.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Salman Khan is not one to hold back from calling a spade a spade. And that was amply on display of late as he blasted trolls and paps on an episode of the reality show he hosts.

Adding to this, Salman Khan Now, on the opening episode of Koffee With Karan ’s final season, he has again addressed his problem with the paparazzi making actors, especially female actors, uncomfortable with certain angles.

The films that we make are films that every Hindustani would be comfortable to see with the whole family. With most of my films, I see a vision, how they are going to turn out. If the director doesn’t see that, that’s where the gadbad happens.”

title: Salman Khan says he spoke for those who do not want to pay paparazzi to take photos of them from inappropriate angles: ‘Girls are uncomfortable’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Salman Khan was the first guest on Koffee With Karan Season 9. (PTI Photo)(PTI09_15_2026_000026B) (PTI) What Salman shared Salman was the first guest on Koffee With Karan season 9, where he further elaborated upon his decision to speak about this issue in the movie industry. It was host Karan Johar who lauded Salman for being vocal about calling out paparazzi for clicking inappropriate pictures of celebrities. Salman shared, “Since this PR has come, there are some people who pay the PR for their sighting or whatever that is called. Airport look etc. There are some who want to do that stuff. I was not speaking about those kinds of people. I was speaking for those people who don't want it. There are really bad angles, and girls are uncomfortable.”

Adding to this, Salman then joked that he wants to meet this person who invented this cell phone and thought of attaching a camera to it. “Every guy who has a phone has a camera attached to it, and it always used to bother me. ‘Guess who?’ From what should be guess?” he asked.

Meanwhile, In the episode of Bigg Boss in September, Salman called out photographers for clicking famous personalities inappropriately. He had shared, “And then the one shot they take from behind, which none of the heroines like? There must be a few who say it’s okay, I don’t mind it. But what about those who don’t like it? When this happens, turn around and slap them. Ask them to click their mother or sister like this and show it to you. Disgusting people."

Notably, The star continued to slam this behaviour and even warned those posting videos like this, “What is this mentality? 90% of the girls that I know and all those who have become mothers now, they never wanted this earlier and don't want this now. I want to see these guys who take these shots. Aur pata chal gaya mujhe ki kaun hai toh phir toh (Once I find out who they are)...”

title: ‘Of course I will have children’: Salman Khan on Koffee with Karan season 9 opener; reveals if he feels lonely without a life partner
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Salman Khan , on the opening episode of Koffee With Karan season 9, didn’t hold back from talking about literally anything under the sun. Including what he meant by ‘still’ being a virgin, 13 years back!

Adding to this, Salman with Karan. While the world constantly speculates why bhai is not getting married, he went a step ahead and talked about having kids. Karan, in a cheeky moment, asked him about his virgin remark.

Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram Salman replied, “That was a way of saying, Karan, that I don’t want to talk about it. You keep saying ‘I am dating so and so person’, but you never know if this person is going to be in your life. Then that person goes ahead and gets married to somebody else. Since I was 16, my father has shared one thing: ‘Yeh personal life tumhara bedroom hai, aur living room poori country hai. Jo aap living room mein bol sakte ho, poori country mein bolo, bedroom yahaan tak nahi aana chahiye’.”

Notably, As Karan moved on to a more emotional subject- about the lack of a life companion- and if he feels lonely, Salman added, “You are the loneliest when nobody wants to be with you... nobody stopped me from having a partner. I am happy with this.” As for missing having kids of his own, the star asserted, “Of course I will have children at some point of time. I was happy for you Karan, when you did that (having kids via surrogacy). Yes, kids will come in."

As per the latest buzz, The soon-to-release episodes of Koffee With Karan's final season are touted to bring back a lot of the Koffee couch veterans- from Shah Rukh Khan to Saif Ali Khan, Kareena Kapoor Khan, and many more.

In further updates, Rishabh Suri is an Assistant Editor, movie critic, and professional overthinker of plot points. He writes for HT City, keeping pace with an industry where news cycles expire long before the popcorn gets cold. He completed his graduation in English Honours from Kirori Mal College, followed by a Master’s degree in English Literature-effectively training his brain to over-analyse classic texts before applying those exact same skills to 3-hour Bollywood blockbusters. He got into the profession when he had barely graduated from college and has been at HT ever since. At HT, Rishabh reviews films with a simple rule: skip the dense academic jargon and get straight to the point. Beyond reviews, as Assistant Editor, he helps navigate the broader circus of showbiz, tracking everything from OTT shifts to sudden ticket-window panics. In a beat driven by loud PR machinery and carefully scripted answers, Rishabh prefers cutting through the noise to focus on how stories get made and why trends shift. When he isn’t writing against a deadline, he is usually sitting in a dark theater, compulsively memorising dialogues. For Rishabh, analysing movies isn't just a day job- it’s a habit he couldn't turn off even if he tried. Read More

title: Homebound actor Vishal Jethwa: I am prepping for a Navratri singing gig next year; I connect more with music than with playing dandiya and garba!
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Having his roots in Gujarat, for star Vishal Jethwa , Navratri and Dandiya celebrations hold a special place. A passionate singer, who likes to express himself, he is looking forward to turning his hobby into professional singing and wants to start from Navratri.

Adding to this, Vishal Jethwa is looking forward to experiment with singing and feels Navratri gig is what he wants to do next! (Photo: Instagram) The star says, “Since I am a Gujarati, from childhood I loved playing garba-dandiya and now as a grown-up, more than playing, I love singing and being in the mahaul where there is a lot of music. Over the period of time, I have realised that I connect with music more by playing dandiya!”

Meanwhile, Jethwa, known for Homebound (2025) and Mardaani 2 (2019), is attending concerts of his friends, including singers Kinjal Dave and Geeta Rabari, this year, and followers might just get a surprise.

Notably, “I had planned to explore myself as a singer and do Navratri concerts this year but unfortunately, it did not work out. I will surely prepare for my music show next year. I keep looking at opportunities when I can express myself as a singer. It won’t be a surprise if I join for a bit and sing at any Dandiya night, but I know it will just be a cameo. Gane ka mauka milega to chodunga nahi,” says the star who will be next seen in Shakti Shalini .

As per the latest buzz, Expressing his passion for singing, he says, “I am very serious about singing and it took me many years to accept that more than acting, I enjoy singing – music and Gujarati folk. But fortunately, I am a better star than a singer. I know that I am a decent singer, but I need to work more on practice and rehearsals. I enjoy singing a lot and in the coming time, it won’t be a surprise if people see me sitting with a harmonium and singing. I am also keen to learn vocals and brush up my skill.”
In further updates, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Vishal Jethwa (@vishaljethwa06)

On top of that, Vishal loves experimenting with fashion during Navratri celebrations. “I believe along with traditional, one should be open to modern dressing which can connect with youngsters and all age groups alongside trending fashion. I like to experiment with my dressing and make sure that our tradition of Gujarat and Garba is infused with contemporary fashion.”

He explains, “If I wear a very traditional dress, it will be too odd, and wearing just a modern dress won’t gel with festivities, so that balance is very important. I believe this way traditional dresses will stay relevant in the future as well, else it will fade off, and that I don’t want to happen.”

title: Indian Youth Congress chief moves Delhi HC against Jantar Mantar’s removal as protest site
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:
Indian Youth Congress’s (IYC) chief Uday Bhanu Chib moved the Delhi high court against Delhi police’s decision to de-notify Jantar Mantar as a designated protest site in the Capital.

Adding to this, Delhi police on Monday denotified Jantar Mantar as a protest site, ending its 33-year-long designation as one of the country’s demonstration hubs. (Representational) Delhi police on Monday denotified Jantar Mantar as a protest site, ending its 33-year-long designation as one of the country’s demonstration hubs. They designated three alternative venues for protests: Ramlila Maidan, Burari Ground in north Delhi, and CBD Ground in east Delhi.
Meanwhile, While the first was spread across 12 acres and hosts thousands all year round, the other two are on the fringes of Delhi — 18km and 12.4km away from Jantar Mantar, respectively.

Notably, The order, titled “Guidelines for Holding Protests or Demonstrations in Delhi”, shared the Union ministry of home affairs constituted a committee to “examine alternative proper venues for citizen’s right for organising protest/demonstrations in place of the existing ‘designated site’”.

As per the latest buzz, “Based on the committee’s recommendations, Jantar Mantar as a protest venue has been de-notified,” the order shared, adding that three new venues were designated for organising protests and demonstrations.
In further updates, The application has been filed in Chib’s petition against Delhi Police’s denial of permission for a protest at Jantar Mantar.

On top of that, This was a day after the Delhi police told the high court on Tuesday that Monday’s notification was passed following a Supreme Court October 9 order earlier this month that nudged authorities to consider alternative, better-equipped spaces where residents could exercise their democratic rights without hindering public safety.

The Supreme Court on October 9 called for a rethink of Delhi’s decades-old arrangement of holding demonstrations at Jantar Mantar, recording that the Delhi Police commissioner and other competent authorities would consider designating an alternative venue with better facilities for peaceful protesters.

title: ‘Unwarranted and unacceptable’: India slams UN human rights office's concerns over Delhi protest
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Ministry of External Affairs ( MEA ) on Wednesday called the concerns expressed by the United Nations Human Rights Office over the Delhi protests “unwarranted” and “unacceptable”, accusing it of interfering in India's internal affairs.

Adding to this, ]MEA Spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal addressing a press conference in New Delhi. (ANI Video Grab) Responding to the remarks during a media briefing, MEA spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal shared the Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR) appeared to be following a selective approach in commenting on protests and law enforcement actions around the world.

Meanwhile, “... the concerns expressed by OHCHR (Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights) are unwarranted and at the same time unacceptable because it amounts to interference in India's internal affairs,” Jaiswal shared.

Notably, “It seems that they have an approach of extreme selectivity because they have not reacted in their public positions on protests which are happening or law enforcement actions which are happening in other parts of the world,” he added.
As per the latest buzz, Jaiswal warned that such an approach could undermine confidence in multilateralism and damage the organisation's credibility.

In further updates, “And if they continue on this path, then obviously it will lead to loss of faith in multilateralism. At the same time, it undermines their credibility as an organisation,” he shared.

On top of that, Earlier, the MEA had rejected the OHCHR's remarks on the events in New Delhi, describing its concerns as “misplaced” and accusing the office of unwarranted interference in India's internal affairs.

In a statement shared by the ministry on X, India shared the right to peaceful assembly was guaranteed by the Constitution and safeguarded by the country's institutions, an independent judiciary and a free media.

title: Arjun Bijlani gives clarification after wife's T-shirt with words referring to Prophet Muhammad sparks backlash: 'She was unaware of the meaning'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Television star Arjun Bijlani and his wife, Neha Swami, have issued a clarification after she of late faced backlash for wearing a T-shirt that featured words in Urdu referring to Prophet Muhammad. Her outfit sparked criticism online, prompting the couple to explain the circumstances behind her wearing it.

Adding to this, Arjun Bijlani and Neha Swami give clarification after T-shirt row. ‘Neha was completely unaware of the meaning of the writing’ In a statement shared by Arjun on his Instagram Stories, the couple clarified that the T-shirt had been gifted to Neha by a fan during their trip to Bangkok. Since the words were written in Urdu, she did not understand their meaning when she wore it.

Meanwhile, The note read, "We would like to address the ongoing situation concerning Neha Swami Bijlani and the T-shirt she was of late spotted wearing, which featured words in Urdu referring to the Prophet. Neha was completely unaware of the meaning and significance of the writing on the T-shirt when she wore it. There was absolutely no intention to hurt, disrespect or offend the religious sentiments of any individual or community. We sincerely respect all religions, faiths and beliefs, and would never knowingly do anything to hurt the sentiments of others."

Notably, While clarifying their stance, Arjun and Neha also criticised the trolls for directing abusive comments and threats at Neha. The note read, "While we understand that people may have strong feelings about matters of religious significance, the trolling, abusive language, curses and threats directed at Neha are deeply distressing and unacceptable. A situation arising from a lack of awareness should not become a reason to subject an individual to online harassment or threats."

As per the latest buzz, The statement further read, "It was a t-shirt gifted by a fan in Bangkok at a mall and we didnt know the meaning of what was written, we celebrate all festivals and we will never hurt anyone's sentiments in any way. We are sorry for what happened unintentionally and we will always be careful in future with regards to the gifts received."

In further updates, The couple concluded their note by urging people to approach the matter with understanding and refrain from targeting Neha and her family, "We request everyone to approach this matter with understanding. sensitivity and compassion, and to refrain from spreading hate or targeting Neha and her family. We believe that mutual respect and dialogue are far more constructive than abuse and intimidation. We hope this clarification helps put the matter into perspective and request everyone to allow the situation to be addressed with dignity and understanding.'
On top of that, View this post on Instagram A post shared by The Host (@thehost.global)

Neha of late wore the t-shirt while attending the birthday party of star Kunal Verma and star Puja Banerjee’s son in Mumbai after which she received backlash on social media. Meanwhile, the row also drew attention after Pakistani star Mishi Khan criticised the couple in an Instagram post and called for a public apology.
