title: Protests kept 2.6 million commuters off Metro; 258 stations fully operational, DMRC tells SC
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) on Wednesday told the Supreme Court that the October 10 protests against chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar had an adverse impact on the lives of ordinary citizens, with ridership falling by nearly 45% as many commuters chose not to travel, even as all scheduled train services continued to operate.

Adding to this, According to the corporation, the remaining 258 stations, which is more than 85% of the network, remained fully operational and accessible to commuters. (File Photo) In an affidavit filed, a day before the matter is scheduled to be heard, the DMRC shared around 3.2 million passengers travelled on its network on October 10, against approximately 5.8 million on a normal second Saturday. It attributed the sharp decline to the protests, which it shared appeared to have prompted people to forego their usual daily activities, including attending work or conducting business.

Meanwhile, The affidavit, filed in response to the Supreme Court’s directions on October 9, seeks to counter allegations that public transport was shut down in defiance of the court’s order. The corporation maintained that there was no reduction in the number of Metro train trips on the day, with 271 trains inducted into service and all 4,157 scheduled trips operated across the network.

Notably, The clarification comes amid contempt proceedings initiated by the top court over restrictions imposed on Metro and railway services ahead of the protest at Jantar Mantar, called by the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) to demand Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation over alleged irregularities in the revision of electoral rolls.

As per the latest buzz, On Sunday, a bench of justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana issued notices to Union home secretary Govind Mohan, Delhi police commissioner Anurag Kumar and DMRC chairperson D Thara, holding that a prima facie case in the contempt pleas against them had been made out. The authorities were directed to file their responses and compliance reports.

In further updates, The DMRC’s affidavit, submitted through its general manager, shared the Metro network comprises 303 stations, of which entry and exit gates at 45 were restricted on October 10 following directions from the Delhi Police. The original police communication had proposed restrictions at 57 stations, but the number was reduced after the Supreme Court’s intervention on October 9 and a subsequent reassessment of security requirements.

On top of that, According to the corporation, the remaining 258 stations, which is more than 85% of the network, remained fully operational and accessible to commuters. It also pointed out that interchange facilities continued uninterrupted at 14 of the 45 affected stations , including major hubs such as Rajiv Chowk, Kashmere Gate, Central Secretariat, Mandi House, Hauz Khas, Dilli Haat-INA and Netaji Subhash Place .
“The entire Metro network, except for the 45 stations specified in the modified notification dated 09.10.2026, remained fully functional throughout the day on 10.10.2026,” the affidavit shared.

title: Sharvari named first-ever brand ambassador of Reva by PNGS
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Sharvari is one of Hindi cinema’s most exciting young leads, with a growing body of work that spans diverse genres, from horror-comedy and action to romance. She made her big-screen debut with Bunty Aur Babli 2 and has since been seen in Munjya, Maharaj, Vedaa, Main Vaapas Aaunga and YRF’s Alpha . She will next be seen in Sooraj Barjatya’s Yeh Prem Mol Liya , slated for rollout in November. Sharvari will be the face of Reva’s brand campaigns across print, digital, outdoor and in-store, beginning with the festive and wedding season.

Adding to this, Amit Modak, CEO, PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery Limited, shared, "Reva is entering a defining phase. Since our listing, we have been expanding with clarity, opening exclusive stores, launching our online platform and preparing to take the brand into new cities, including key markets in North India. As we grow beyond our home ground, we need a face that resonates nationally while staying true to who we are. Sharvari does exactly that. Her appeal cuts across regions and age groups, and she will help us introduce Reva and the value of a certified natural diamond to many more customers across India."

Meanwhile, Aditya Modak, Director, Reva by PNGS, shared, "Our very first brand ambassador had to be someone who truly reflects the Reva woman, and Sharvari was a natural choice in every sense. She is rooted, she is real, and she has collected her place through her own effort, much like a natural diamond is shaped over time. Today's woman buys diamonds not only for weddings but for herself, for her milestones and for her every day. Sharvari embodies that confidence, and together we want to make natural diamonds a part of more women's stories."

Notably, Sharvari, Brand Ambassador, Reva, shared, “Being the first face of Reva makes this association especially exciting for me. As a Maharashtrian, P. N. Gadgil & Sons is a name I’ve known and associated with trust and tradition for as long as I can remember. What drew me to Reva is how it brings natural diamonds into the everyday, with designs that feel modern while still holding on to the timelessness of the stone. I’m happy to be part of a brand that makes diamonds feel relevant to different moments in a woman’s life, from ordinary days to the most special occasions.”

As per the latest buzz, The Sharvari partnership comes as Reva accelerates its retail and digital expansion. The brand currently operates 38 stores, comprising 5 exclusive brand outlets and 34 shop-in-shop counters within the P. N. Gadgil & Sons network, with a strong presence across Maharashtra and a growing footprint in Gujarat and Karnataka. Recent openings include exclusive stores at Amanora Mall, Pune (July 2026) and Nashik (September 2026).

In further updates, Following its IPO in March 2026, Reva is on track to open around 15 new company-owned exclusive stores within 24 months of listing. The rollout will focus primarily on Tier 1 cities, with selective expansion into Tier 2 cities and metro markets across Maharashtra and key North India markets. In September 2026, Reva also launched its e-commerce platform, revadiamonds.com, bringing its collections to customers across the country. With a pan-India appeal, Sharvari will be central to introducing Reva to these new markets and a new generation of diamond buyers.

title: Kangana Ranaut backs Bittu Tabahi after river he cleaned for 8 months gets polluted again: ‘People cry about rights’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Kangana Ranaut has expressed support for content creator Surendra Singh Choudhary, aka Bittu Tabahi , after he was left heartbroken to find the Ajnar River in his village in Madhya Pradesh’s Rajgarh district polluted again, just two months after he spent eight months cleaning it. On Tuesday, the content creator shared a video expressing his disappointment at how people had disregarded his efforts to keep the river clean.

Adding to this, Kangana Ranaut expresses support for content creator Bittu Tabahi. Kangana expresses support for Bittu Tabahi, slams public for polluting river Bittu’s video has been doing the rounds on social media. Kangana shared a news report about the incident and wrote, “This is so sad but also the brutal reality of our nation, people cry about rights all day but never think about their duties.”

Meanwhile, In the video, Bittu is heard saying, “Mere aanth mahine ki mehnat yun barbaad ho jayegi, maine kabhi socha nahi tha (I never imagined that eight months of my hard work would go to waste like this).” The clip shows the river strewn with waste, including flower petals, clothes and plastic discarded during religious rituals.

Notably, After seeing the river polluted again, Bittu resumes his cleaning efforts. He is seen removing garbage from the water and says in Hindi, “I don’t know how to swim, but I still step into the river to remove the garbage.”
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Surendra singh choudhry (@bittu_tabahi)

In further updates, Bittu became a widely shared sensation after sharing videos of himself cleaning the heavily polluted Ajnar River in his village. He spent eight months cleaning the river on his own, without external help or safety gear, often using his bare hands.

On top of that, His efforts collected him recognition on social media, including a shout-out from industrialist Anand Mahindra and a job offer from a Dutch NGO. In September, Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Mohan Yadav also felicitated him and lauded his efforts to clean the Ajnar River. Bittu currently has 1.9 million followers on Intagram.

Bittu later participated in the Yamuna cleaning campaign in Delhi and was also seen taking part in cleaning drives in Gurugram, Mumbai and other cities. During his a three-day cleanup campaign in Delhi in September, Bittu had collected approximately 585 kg of waste with a team, as per reports.

Shows like these bring together multiple teams, partners and businesses, all working towards one shared goal: delivering a great experience for followers. It’s this collective effort that makes the live entertainment business exciting, and we’re happy to continue being a part of it,” Kumar shared.

title: SC Constitution's watchdog, must bite if warnings don't work: Ex-Justice Kurian Joseph amid anti-CEC protests
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Former Supreme Court justice Kurian Joseph has shared constitutional courts must do more than raise concerns when their interventions fail to protect democracy, drawing an analogy between the judiciary and a watchdog entrusted with guarding the Constitution.

Adding to this, Justice Joseph shared declining public confidence in constitutional institutions had made peaceful public protests necessary when Parliament and the judiciary failed to protect democratic principles. (HT photo) “We have heard that famous saying that the barking dog seldom bites. But this watchdog, this guardian (the Supreme Court), is bound to bite also if the barking does not lead to the desired result,” Justice Joseph was quoted as saying by Bar and Bench.

Meanwhile, According to a LiveLaw report, the former SC justice also shared that the Chief Election Commissioner is “an institution, not a person” and the Supreme Court, as the Constitution’s watchdog, is “bound to bite” if its warnings don't work.

Notably, Speaking at a constitutional convention on the theme “Independence of Election Commission of India – Compromised?”, he stressed that courts must fulfil their constitutional responsibilities when institutions face threats to their independence.
As per the latest buzz, The event was organised by the Indian Association of Lawyers (IAL) of Kerala at the Kerala High Court Chamber Complex.

In further updates, His remarks come amid protests in Delhi demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar over allegations of irregularities in the revision of electoral rolls. The demonstrations have involved mass detentions, restrictions on movement and disruptions to public services, prompting the Supreme Court to intervene.

On top of that, Justice Joseph shared declining public confidence in constitutional institutions had made peaceful public protests necessary when Parliament and the judiciary failed to protect democratic principles.
Citing socialist leader Dr Ram Manohar Lohia, he shared, “When the Parliament and courts fail, then the street would come to our rescue.”

title: HC refuses interim injunction against release of ‘Queen Forever’ on Phantom Studios’ plea
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The Bombay high court on Wednesday refused to grant an interim injunction against Jiostar India Pvt Ltd. and the production and rollout of their forthcoming movie titled ‘Queen Forever’.

Adding to this, Star and BJP MP Kangana Ranaut. (Rahul Singh) A single-judge bench of Justice Sandeep Marne declined relief to Phantom Studios India Pvt Ltd, co-producer of the 2014 box-office hit ‘Queen’, which shared they and Jiostar India Pvt Ltd were joint and equal owners of 50% of all intellectual property rights in ‘Queen’.

Meanwhile, The court noted ‘Queen’ was a critically acclaimed and commercially successful movie that has acquired substantial goodwill and ‘Queen Forever’ was a purported sequel being produced by Jiostar India Pvt Ltd, co-producer of ‘Queen’, and like the original movie, stars Kangana Ranaut.

Notably, According to the suit filed by Phantom Studios, the co-production agreement expressly and unambiguously provided that derivative rights in the movie – including the right to create sequels, prequels, remakes, or any other work based on the movie or its characters, story or other elements – vest jointly and equally in both the parties, the suit shared.

As per the latest buzz, Phantom Studios described ‘Queen’ as a critically acclaimed and commercially successful movie that has acquired substantial goodwill since 2014. The studio shared it had not given consent for any sequels, adaptations or derivative works on the movie; it had also issued several caution notices to Jiostar since April 2026 to cease and desist from proceeding with purported plans for making a sequel or any other content that was likely to create any association with ‘Queen’. Despite the notices, Jiostar refused to disclose any details of the project, Phantom Studios shared.

In further updates, Citing extreme urgency as the movie is as per reports scheduled for rollout in a few months, Phantom Studios sought temporary injunction restraining Jiostar, the producer, and the representatives, from taking any step towards “making, developing, producing, shooting, completing, releasing, distributing, broadcasting, streaming, marketing, promoting, advertising, or exploiting” the “sequel, prequel, remake, adaptation or derivative work” under the title ‘Queen Forever’ or ‘Queen 2’ without its prior written consent.

title: Adivi Sesh writes to Assam government over reported resort development near Kaziranga National Park
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Kaziranga, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is known for its biodiversity and population of the endangered greater one-horned rhinoceros. Concerns over construction and tourism infrastructure in ecologically sensitive areas have raised questions about how development can be balanced with the protection of wildlife habitats and natural corridors.

Adding to this, In his letter, Adivi called for greater transparency regarding the land involved and urged the government to assess the possible long-term consequences of the proposed development before making decisions that could affect the region’s ecosystem.
Meanwhile, “Nature does not belong to us; we are only its temporary custodians,” he shared, highlighting the importance of protecting Kaziranga’s wildlife and natural heritage.
Notably, Acknowledging the economic benefits of tourism, Adivi shared development in ecologically sensitive regions should be guided by long-term environmental considerations.

As per the latest buzz, “I understand that tourism can generate employment, create opportunities and contribute to the local economy. But development must be planned with a long-term vision, particularly when it concerns ecologically sensitive regions,” he shared.
In further updates, The star also questioned whether commercial development was necessary in every area, pointing to the potential consequences for wildlife and the environment.
On top of that, “Sustainable tourism should be about experiencing nature while preserving it, not about changing the very landscape that makes a place special in the first place,” he added.

Adivi also highlighted the importance of protecting wildlife corridors, warning that habitat loss and disruptions to natural ecosystems can be difficult to reverse. He referred to the greater one-horned rhinoceros as a symbol of Assam’s biodiversity and stressed the need to safeguard its habitat.

title: Harvard vs Harvard: Support from one, criticism from another over Delhi protests
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

A group of 44 Harvard scholars and professionals on Wednesday raised concerns over what they described as attacks on India's constitutional institutions, including the Election Commission and the Supreme Court, asserting that while dissent is a right, questioning institutional credibility without evidence is not.

Adding to this, On Saturday, October 10, about 41,000 security personnel turned the Capital into a fortress on Saturday to thwart the planned protest and launched an unprecedented clampdown that saw the detention of 7,000 people and left large chunks of Delhi deserted. (File/ANI) In a statement, the signatories, who identified themselves as concerned citizens of India, the world's oldest and largest democracy, shared descriptions of the country as being under “siege” and constitutional authorities as “thieves” or “compromised” raised serious questions about attempts to erode public trust in democratic institutions.
Meanwhile, The signatories include lawyers, policymakers, civil servants, scientists and academicians.

Notably, "We are deeply concerned by the negative public discourse and concerted campaign against India's constitutional institutions, including the Election Commission, the Supreme Court, the office of the Honourable Chief Justice of India, and Parliament," the statement shared, reported news agency PTI.

As per the latest buzz, The signatories reiterated that while dissent is a fundamental democratic right, making unsubstantiated allegations that damage the credibility of institutions is not. They shared the statement was issued out of a sense of responsibility, adding that silence in such circumstances should not be mistaken for indifference.

In further updates, The statement, titled “Constitutional Responsibility, Rule of Law, and Institutional Integrity”, also flagged concerns over reports that Harvard University's name was being used to lend legitimacy to a political campaign without proper authorisation.

On top of that, The scholars shared actions taken by law enforcement agencies to maintain public order should be subject to fair scrutiny, but argued that sweeping allegations and abusive language could not replace evidence, due process or accountability.

“The dignity of public servants and the offices they hold must be respected. The Constitution, rule of law, and civil liberties must be respected at all times, not just when it suits our interests,” the statement shared.

title: Abhishek Pathak rules out part 4 plans despite ₹500 crore success of Ajay Devgn's Drishyam 3: ‘We had to stop it at some point’
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

With Drishyam 3 continuing its strong run at the ticket-window, director Abhishek Pathak believes the franchise has reached its natural conclusion. The filmmaker has ruled out the possibility of a fourth instalment, saying the story has ended on a fitting note. Starring Ajay Devgn , the third movie has crossed ₹ 500 crore rupees worldwide in 12 days.

Adding to this, Abhishek Pathak reveals plans for Drishyam 4. Abhishek Pathak says there won't be Drishyam 4 In an interview with Screen, Abhishek shared he hopes October 2 continues to be celebrated as Drishyam Day and added, "All of us believe this is the last part of the movie. Obviously, the audience is loving it, and talking about it. But Drishyam isn’t the franchise where we can just decide to make another movie. It’s very much dependent on the story, and the story has ended. I always thought the ending was very poetic. It’s a love letter to the franchise."

Meanwhile, Abhishek further shared, "The closure is beautifully done. That’s what people liked about it. A lot of people are telling me there can be a part 4. If you get to it, there can be enormous amount of story to it, but that’s not the point. We had to stop it at some point, and this was a beautiful ending to the franchise. Drishyam 3 is only in its second week right now. People are still coming to theatres in huge numbers. The second weekend was more than ₹ 60 crore rupees. That’s a figure too many films don’t achieve even in their lifetime. So, let’s not spoil it for them."

Notably, Ajay Devgn’s Drishyam 3: The Conclusion has emerged as one of the biggest box-office successes of 2026, crossing the ₹ 500 crore rupees mark worldwide within just 12 days of its rollout. Directed by Abhishek Pathak, the crime thriller has collected ₹ 501.80 crore rupees globally, including ₹ 323.50 crore rupees net in India, according to Sacnilk. The movie opened with ₹ 62 crore rupees on its first day and collected ₹ 245.50 crore rupees in its opening week. Its strong second weekend further boosted its earnings, helping it become Ajay’s highest-grossing movie ever. It's now the second highest-grossing Indian movie of 2026, surpassing Border 2, Toxic, Jana Nayagan and Peddi's lifetime hauls.

As per the latest buzz, The movie sees Ajay's return as Vijay Salgaonkar, whose carefully guarded secrets face a fresh threat as a determined Crime Branch officer reopens the case. Tabu, Shriya Saran, Ishita Dutta and Jaideep Ahlawat also feature in the movie. The movie received praise from Mohanlal, who shared, "I watched Drishyam: The Conclusion, and I am truly impressed with the way they have brought this much-loved journey to a befitting end. Congratulations to Abhishek Pathak, Kumar Mangat Pathak, Ajay Devgn, and the entire cast and crew on a job so well done."

title: Drishyam The Conclusion show-sharing row: Panorama Studios’ Week 3 show demands put exhibitors in a fix as Nayyi Navelli, Prahaar, Jailer 2 gear up for release
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

A trade source told Bollywood Hungama , “The distributors have asked single-screen cinemas to allot at least 3 shows to Drishyam The Conclusion from October 16. In two-screen theatres, they have sought 5 shows, while in three-screen cinemas, they have asked for 6 shows, including 1 morning show. In four-screen multiplexes, their request is for 7 shows, including 1 morning show, and in five-screen multiplexes, they have asked for 8 shows, including 1 morning show. In six-screen cinemas, they have sought 10 shows, while for theatres with seven screens or more, their demand is for 15 shows.”

Adding to this, The source continued, “Their request has put exhibitors in a dilemma, as several films are lined up for rollout this week, including Nayyi Navelli, Prahaar, Street Fighter, Jailer 2, Ranabaali , etc. All these films have the potential to attract audiences, including the last two, which will also rollout in Hindi. As a result, cinemas are trying to negotiate with the distributors of various films and arrive at a consensus.”

Meanwhile, It is for this reason that advance bookings for the soon-to-release week are yet to open at several cinemas. When asked when the issue is likely to be resolved, the source replied, “It's difficult to say, going by recent experiences. The matter might be resolved by Wednesday morning or evening, or it could even extend to Thursday, just a day before the new releases arrive in cinemas.”

Notably, An industry insider commented, “ Drishyam The Conclusion still has a lot of gas left in the tank and can continue to attract audiences despite the competition. The makers have also asked exhibitors to sell tickets at regular prices, which should further entice moviegoers.”

title: 'Dande ka jawab': Rahul Gandhi uses flute in response to ‘police baton’ as protesters allege assault
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi on Wednesday held a press conference to counter what he described as authorities' “danda" (stick) treatment to the growing protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

Adding to this, Congress MP Rahul Gandhi at a press conference on Wednesday Gandhi introduced a flute artist - Samar - who played ' Vaishnav jan to tene kahiye' song on the instrument in a symbolic answer to ‘danda’.
Meanwhile, "Dande ka jawab dande se [A stick counter to sticks]," Rahul Gandhi shared.

Notably, “I was detained on Oct 11, but Bajrang Dal and RSS goons made them detain us. I have their video threatening peaceful protesters with sticks and stones. These goons went and told the police, who detained us. Phones were snatched and formatted. At least 15 females were there. July 20 also one RAF personnel hit me with a stick,” Samar shared.
As per the latest buzz, Rahul Gandhi introduced another person — an NSUI functionary — who he described as a “ sherni ” (tigress), saying she was beaten and still wasn't deterred.

In further updates, The female NSUI functionary alleged they had been “beaten” during detention. Sje accused a woman constable — Chanchal Yadav — of “dragging” her when taking her to the Connaught Place Police Station.

On top of that, “They took us to the police station and in room 107, there were women officers in civilian clothing. I was beaten in the room and my legs have turned blue,” the NSUI protester alleged, adding that her ears also turned blue.
The NSUI protester shared demonstrators had attempted to stop a bus and sit underneath it to ensure their protest continued.

title: Mrunal Thakur on 'Pooja Meri Jaan': A woman's 'no' doesn't mean 'try harder'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Mumbai, Star Mrunal Thakur says she offered to audition for her role in "Pooja Meri Jaan" after listening to its one-line pitch about a trial in which the idea that a woman's "no means no, it does not mean try harder" is challenged.

Adding to this, Mrunal Thakur on 'Pooja Meri Jaan': A woman's 'no' doesn't mean 'try harder' Thakur, known for her roles in movies such as "Sita Ramam", "Hi Nanna", "Super 30", "Batla House" and "Dacoit", shared it is rare to come across characters with that kind of range.

Meanwhile, "The movie was not offered to me. I asked the filmmakers if I could do and be a part of it, I asked for an audition and shamelessly I was like, 'Sir, you've to cast me. I've to play Pooja'.

Notably, "I found out about it via my agent who shared, 'There's a movie being made which is about two girls fighting this case where 'no means no, it doesn't mean try harder'. I was like, 'I've to be a part of it. Can I meet? So, this is the second time in my life I've reached out to a filmmaker that was Dino . I'm just incredibly happy that he saw that faith and he saw that I can pull it off," the star told PTI in an interview.

As per the latest buzz, "Pooja Meri Jaan" follows Pooja , a free-spirited woman who rejects a marriage proposal from her longtime friend. After he dies by suicide, leaving behind a note blaming her for his death, Pooja faces public backlash, with many holding her responsible. Her lawyer friend Sana steps in to defend her.
In further updates, Thakur recalled her conversation with a man in his 40s during her recent visit to Delhi, who thanked her for the movie because it made him aware of the importance of consent.

On top of that, "He shared that, 'There were so many times we didn't realise that we were putting pressure on a girl. When one of our friends liked a girl in college and she kept saying no. We kept telling him that he should try again.
"We didn't realise what she must be going through. So, I feel appalled. But today, I understood a woman's perspective of what she must be going through'," Thakur shared recounting the conversation.

title: Khosla Ka Ghosla 2 release postponed to March 5, 2027
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The makers revealed the revised date on social media with a new poster. Sharing the update, they wrote, “Deal Pakki! The Khoslas are ready to take possession of cinemas with #KhoslaKaGhosla2, arriving on the big screen on 5th March 2027!”

Adding to this, The announcement confirms a delay of several months for the sequel, which brings back characters from the much-loved 2006 comedy Khosla Ka Ghosla . The original movie, directed by Dibakar Banerjee, revolved around a middle-class Delhi family caught up in a property dispute.
Meanwhile, Anupam Kher and Boman Irani return to the franchise
Notably, Khosla Ka Ghosla 2 is directed by Prashant Bhagia and sees Anupam Kher and Boman Irani reprise their respective roles as Kamal Kishore Khosla and property dealer Kishan Khurana.

As per the latest buzz, The makers have not revealed the full storyline yet. However, the sequel is expected to revisit the themes that defined the original movie, including middle-class aspirations, property disputes and the schemes that emerge when the Khosla family finds itself dealing with another challenge.

In further updates, Backed by T-Series Films and Tandav Films, the movie is produced by Bhushan Kumar, Krishan Kumar, Savita Raj Hiremath and Raaj Hiremath. Khosla Ka Ghosla 2 is now scheduled to rollout in theatres on March 5, 2027.

title: ‘Where does CJP go when issues arise in other states?’ CM Rekha Gupta amid anti-CEC protests in Delhi
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:
Delhi chief minister Rekha Gupta questioned the Cockroach Janta Party on Wednesday amid the recent protests against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar in the capital.

Adding to this, The chief minister shared the protests have caused Delhi "losses worth thousands of crores" and that this disruption is due to the ongoing sit-ins and protests. (Vipin Kumar/HT Photo) Addressing a press conference, the BJP leader questioned whether the pressure group has spoken about issues in other states. Track LIVE updates on Delhi protests

Meanwhile, “It is surprising that the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) is being questioned in this manner, even though it is not being conducted for the first time in the country. Such revisions have been carried out on numerous occasions over the years by the Election Commission. This has been the practice regardless of which party was in power, either at the state or the central level. Why were there no voices raised against it earlier? Why are such objections being raised now?” the Delhi CM told reporters.
Notably, The chief minister shared the protests have caused Delhi "losses worth thousands of crores" and that this disruption is due to the ongoing sit-ins and protests.

As per the latest buzz, "You want to oppose the system functioning in a democracy simply because you have failed to form the government. I want to ask... if you form the government in Tamil Nadu or Kerala, will such an exercise not take place there? Does this issue concern you only in states where you have failed to form the government?" Gupta asked.
In further updates, She also fired a salvo at CJP, reiterating the BJP's claim that the pressure group is the Aam Aadmi Party's "B-team."

On top of that, "Where does this CJP go when issues arise in those states? Why does it not go there to stage protests? Now, following the murder linked to drugs yesterday, why doesn't CJP go to Punjab and stage a protest? Why does it function as the Aam Aadmi Party's 'B-team', working only on the political agenda conveyed by the Aam Aadmi Party?" Gupta shared.

Gupta's remarks come after CJP leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were sent to five-day judicial custody over their breach of Jantar Mantar, which was de-notified as a protest site earlier this week.

title: Farmers' protest at Karnataka toll plaza disrupts NH-48 traffic, Maharashtra Police suggest alternative routes
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Maharashtra Highway Police on Wednesday urged motorists, particularly those travelling long distances, to use alternative routes to avoid congestion along the National Highway 48 (NH 48), connecting Delhi with Chennai, due to a farmer protest at the Kognoli toll plaza in Karnataka.

Adding to this, The protest began on Tuesday over demands related to sugarcane and ethanol prices. (PTI) In an advisory, they shared the protest has affected traffic from Maharashtra towards Belagavi and Bengaluru on the NH 48. It added protest began on Tuesday morning over demands related to sugarcane and ethanol prices. The agitation was expected to end soon, but it was still underway, and there is no clarity on when it would be called off, the advisory shared. Motorists, particularly those travelling long distances, should plan their journeys accordingly, it added.

Meanwhile, Special Inspector General (Kolhapur Range) Ranjan Kumar Sharma shared it may take some time for the situation to return to normal. “Therefore, commuters are advised to avoid travelling towards Karnataka via NH 48 through Kolhapur, Satara and Pune unless necessary, and use alternative routes. We will issue an update once the situation improves.”

Notably, Kumar suggested using alternative routes. For passenger vehicles, including cars, jeeps, private vehicles and buses, he suggested the Satara-Rahimatpur-Pusesavalii-Vita–Tasgaon-Miraj-Kagawad-Raybag-Gokak–Belagavi route. For goods and heavy vehicles, including trucks, container vehicles and trailers, the Satara-Karad-Peth Naka-Islampur-Ashta-Miraj-Kagwad-Raybag-Gokak–Belagavi route.

As per the latest buzz, Police superintendent (Highway Safety Patrol, Pune ) Shivaji Pawar shared there was currently no obstruction to traffic within Maharashtra’s jurisdiction and vehicles could continue moving smoothly within the state. “The impact of the agitation on interstate traffic on NH 48 must be taken into account while planning journeys.”

In further updates, Pawar shared the authorities have requested Google Maps to mark the affected stretch as blocked due to the protest, display traffic delays and suggest alternative routes until the agitation ends.

On top of that, Police shared they would provide an update once traffic movement returns to normal. They advised motorists, bus operators and heavy vehicle drivers to follow the traffic advisory and cooperate with the police to avoid unnecessary congestion and delays.

title: 'Agitations for a common cause': CJP's Dipke on INDIA bloc amid anti-CEC protests in Delhi
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke on Wednesday addressed questions over his outfit's stand towards the INDIA bloc and shared they have a common cause - fighting against Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar.

Adding to this, Nagpur: Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke, in Nagpur, Wednesday, Oct. 14, 2026. Dipke on Wednesday alleged that Prime Minister Narendra Modi was imposing an "unofficial emergency" after two CJP leaders were sent to five-day judicial custody for allegedly trespassing into Jantar Mantar in New Delhi. (PTI Photo) (PTI10_14_2026_000027B) (PTI) Dipke shared the CJP is an independent pressure group and will always be one. “But that does not mean we are against INDIA bloc,” he shared.

Meanwhile, "...We all have a common cause and are fighting against Gyanesh Kumar, who is rigging elections and helping Narendra Modi to stay in power...Cockroach Janta Party is an independent pressure group and it will always be an independent pressure group. But it doesn't mean that we are against the INDIA bloc. Our and the INDIA bloc's agitations are for a common cause," Dipke shared while in conversation with media persons on Wednesday.
Notably, Asked if CJP is getting registered as a political party, Dipke dismissed any such plan. “No, there is nothing like that.”

As per the latest buzz, Dipke's clarification comes amid questions being raised on CJP over not openly backing the INDIA bloc's protest moves against CEC Gyanesh Kumar, who is facing calls for resignation over alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR).

In further updates, The INDIA bloc on Monday led march to Supreme Court against Gyanesh Kumar, an agitation that turned mammoth with thousands joining Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi and several other opposition leaders. AISA's Neha Bora also led the march along with the Gandhis.

On top of that, The questions over CJP's strategy come amid the active participation of AISA's Neha Bora in INDIA bloc's protests, including Monday's march to the Supreme Court alongside Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi and other Opposition leaders.

While Bora's participation has highlighted the involvement of student activists in the Opposition's campaign against Gyanesh Kumar, CJP has stopped short of openly backing the INDIA bloc, with Dipke reiterating that his outfit would retain its identity as an independent pressure group despite the common cause.

title: Aishwarya Rai’s young co-star shares BTS pics from their ad film shoot, calls her ‘embodiment of love, kindness, and grace’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Aishwarya Rai Bachchan was appointed global ambassador for JW Marriott in June this year. The brand has launched its new ‘Stay in the Moment’ campaign, encouraging travellers to slow down, reconnect with loved ones and find meaning in moments that often pass unnoticed. A child star who featured alongside Aishwarya in the campaign has now shared behind-the-scenes moments from the ad shoot and penned a note praising the star.

Adding to this, Aishwarya Rai with her ad movie shoot co-star. Aishwarya Rai's ad movie co-star praises her On Tuesday, child star Namah Singh Deewana shared pictures and videos from his ad shoot with Aishwarya. title: Congress will face defeat in 2029: Amit Shah hits out at Rahul Gandhi amid anti-CEC protests
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

Union home minister Amit Shah on Tuesday hit out at the Opposition, saying the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) will return to power with a resounding majority in 2029, hours after Congress leader Rahul Gandhi vowed that the ongoing protests against chief election commissioner Gyanesh Kumar will continue.

Adding to this, "The Constitution has been torn up and thrown away. We are fighting together to restore democratic rule, genuine democratic rule in this country,” Gandhi shared after hosting leaders at his 5, Sunehri Bagh Road residence. (PTI) Citing the outcome of recent bypolls in states such as Gujarat, Rajasthan and West Bengal, where the Bharatiya Janata Party won, Shah shared the Congress leadership, particularly the Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha Gandhi, should reflect on recent defeats.

Meanwhile, “Rahul Gandhi should engage in self-reflection by learning from the election results. Instead of questioning the election process with every defeat, the Congress should reflect on its acceptability among the people. The trust of the people is collected not through mere allegations and propaganda, but through public outreach and public service,” he shared.

Notably, Earlier in the day, the Opposition revealed a “mission to restore democracy” that might include a political fight against the Union government’s decision to de-notify Jantar Mantar as a protest site. The parties also agreed to wait for the Supreme Court’s decision on their petition filed on Monday before another stir in Delhi .

As per the latest buzz, The leaders hailed Monday’s march to the Supreme Court as a major achievement and decided to form an INDIA plus group to accommodate political parties, activists, students and other organisations. It even discussed plans for a mock Parliament and flash agitations.

In further updates, “We are all standing here together as one. As I shared yesterday, there are no parallel protests. There is one singular protest, and the protest has one mission: restoration of democracy in India. Democracy has been destroyed in this country. The election system has been destroyed. The Constitution has been torn up and thrown away. We are fighting together to restore democratic rule, genuine democratic rule in this country,” Gandhi shared after hosting leaders from 12 parties, civil society members and student organisations at his 5, Sunehri Bagh Road residence.

On top of that, “The one method of expression of democracy was Jantar Mantar and now the government has decided that Jantar Mantar can no longer be used to express democratic feelings. Well, we are going to challenge that idea. It is not going to be so simple for the government to decide that the Indian people will not fight for their voice. The people who have done this, they need to understand that the net is closing around them. It is not going to be so simple that you can destroy the Indian Constitution and get away with it,” Gandhi added.

The developments came after a week of protests where tens of thousands of people hit the streets, braving expansive metro closures, internet shutdown, prohibitory orders and 40,000 security personnel who turned the Capital into a virtual fortress and sparked row by dragging, manhandling and detaining many agitators. While the Opposition is seeking the removal of Kumar and scrapping the controversial special intensive revision, the BJP blames them for trying to destabilise constitutional bodies to deflect attention from their own political and electoral failures.

title: Jantar Mantar denotification as protest site based on Supreme Court orders: Delhi Police tells high court
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Delhi Police on Tuesday told the Delhi High Court that they denotified Jantar Mantar as a designated protest site in the Capital following a Supreme Court order earlier this month that nudged authorities to consider alternative, better-equipped spaces where residents could exercise their democratic rights without hindering public safety.

Adding to this, Members of the Disha Students’ Organisation stage a protest against the restrictions on demonstrations at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi. (Sanchit Khanna/HT Photo) “We denotified Jantar Mantar after Supreme Court’s order dated October 9,” the Delhi Police told the single-judge bench of justice Amit Mahajan.

Meanwhile, The submission was made while the court was hearing a petition filed last week by Indian Youth Congress (IYC) president Uday Bhanu Chib against Delhi Police’s denial of permission for a protest at Jantar Mantar.
Notably, Delhi Police was represented by additional solicitor general Chetan Sharma and standing counsels Ashish Dixit and Amit Tiwari.

As per the latest buzz, The Supreme Court on October 9 called for a rethink of Delhi’s decades-old arrangement of holding demonstrations at Jantar Mantar, recording that the Delhi Police commissioner and other competent authorities would consider designating an alternative venue with better facilities for peaceful protesters.

In further updates, A bench comprising chief justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant and justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana shared the national capital needed a larger, better-equipped space where citizens could exercise their democratic right to protest without compromising public safety, access to emergency services or the interests of other residents. “It is high time that some other place with amenities for peaceful protestors need to be identified and designated,” the bench shared in its order.

On top of that, Delhi Police on Monday denotified Jantar Mantar as a protest site, ending its 33-year-long designation as one of the country’s demonstration hubs. They designated three alternative venues for protests: Ramlila Maidan, Burari Ground in north Delhi, and CBD Ground in east Delhi.

The order, titled “Guidelines for Holding Protests or Demonstrations in Delhi”, shared the Union ministry of home affairs constituted a committee to “examine alternative proper venues for citizen’s right for organising protest demonstrations in place of the existing ‘designated site’”.

title: Benedict Garrett did not know who Amitabh Bachchan was; calls Salman Khan, Pawan Kalyan's bodyguards' machine guns distracting | Interview
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Mumbai-based British star Benedict Garrett has been working in India since 2022 and has collaborated with some of the country's biggest names. He has shared the screen with Amitabh Bachchan , Salman Khan , Yash, Pawan Kalyan, Vijay Deverakonda, Vijay Sethupathi and others throughout his career. In an interview with Hindustan Times, the star, however, admits that he did not realise the extent of most of his co-stars’ stardom while shooting with them. Bodyguards carrying machine guns and fawning on set was the giveaway.

Adding to this, In 2022, Benedict starred in an ad for Dabur Lal featuring Amitabh, but did not know anything about the Bollywood veteran’s stardom. “I had begun to watch a little of Indian cinema before coming here, but it’s not something I grew up with,” he explains, adding, “So, when I landed, I remember doing an advert with Amitabh Bachchan in my first year. At the time, my agent shared, he’s like the king of Bollywood. Oh, okay, I didn’t know. Because I wasn’t really fully aware.”
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Benedict Garrett (@benedictgarrett)

Notably, The star says he has been lucky over the last four-and-a-half years to have worked with Indian actors who taught him a great deal. “10 years ago, if you’d asked me about living in India, I never would’ve thought it. I’d consider visiting it, but would never live here, necessarily. So, having worked with so many big names, I have to pinch myself to believe it. I’ve been very fortunate and lucky to work with not just big names, but interesting people to learn from, to talk to, to watch, and perform with, which has been really helpful in my acting career as well,” he adds.

As per the latest buzz, Benedict, who acted in films such as Baby John, Jawan, Toxic and Hari Hara Veera Mallu, says that he likes being ignorant about his co-stars’ stardom, no matter who he’s acting with, because it means he doesn’t turn up to set like a fanboy. “I worked with Salman Khan, and yeah, with Yash and Pawan Kalyan. I prefer not to almost know. But I have to be honest anyway. When I turn up, I just try to be professional,” he says, adding, “I don’t want to fawn over. I just try to be like a co-worker with anybody. I try not to let that get in the way.”
In further updates, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Benedict Garrett (@benedictgarrett)

On top of that, The star then chuckles and adds, “It can be a little bit difficult when there's a whole team of bodyguards and somebody holding a machine gun on the side. So, it can be a little bit distracting sometimes. But that was the case with Pawan Kalyan , and with Salman Khan, some people with big guns. But apart from that, it's relatively, fairly a normal process.”

Benedict’s next movie Ranabaali is hitting screens on October 16. He also has the Marathi sports drama Khashaba, an independent Hindi legal drama shot in Australia, Prashanth Neel’s Telugu movie Dragon with Jr NTR, and a few other films. “You know, you end up working with some amazing productions and people on some low-budget films, too. We have new directors, young people who are coming through. So, I just want to open myself to all sorts of opportunities and see what’s out there,” he rounds off.

title: Drishyam 3 box office collection day 12: Ajay Devgn’s crime thriller jumps 36% on second Tuesday after major Monday crash, crosses ₹323 crore
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

Drishyam 3 ticket-window earnings day 12: Drishyam: The Conclusion has shown signs of recovery at the ticket-window after a sharp dip on its second Monday. The Ajay Devgn starrer rolled out in theatres on October 2 and became his strong opening day in his career. The second Tuesday is witnessing a good jump after it dipped massively on second Monday.

Adding to this, Drishyam 3 ticket-window earnings day 12: After Monday crash, Ajay Devgn’s movie sees a Tuesday turnaround. Drishyam 3 ticket-window earnings by 10 PM According to trade tracker Sacnilk, the movie collected ₹ 8.61 crore rupees on day 12 across 14,832 shows, marking an increase of 36% over Monday’s ₹ 6.25 crore rupees . The second Tuesday's growth offers a positive sign as it continues its theatrical run. After collecting ₹ 22.50 crore rupees on its second Sunday, Drishyam 3: The Conclusion saw its earnings fall by 72.22% on Monday, bringing in ₹ 6.25 crore rupees. However, Tuesday brought a change in the trend.

Meanwhile, Drishyam 3: The Conclusion had a strong first week at the domestic ticket-window, collecting ₹ 245.50 crore rupees . In its second week, the net collection has reached ₹ 323.86 crore rupees .

Notably, Directed by Abhishek Pathak, Drishyam 3: The Conclusion brings Vijay Salgaonkar's story towards its final chapter, with the character once again facing the consequences of his past and mounting pressure from the law. The movie's opening-day collection of ₹ 62 crore rupees and opening weekend total of ₹ 176.50 crore rupees gave it a strong start at the ticket-window.
As per the latest buzz, Its Tuesday growth is encouraging after Monday's decline, but sustained collections will be needed for it to reach the ₹ 350 crore rupees mark in India net earnings.

In further updates, Directed by Abhishek Pathak , Drishyam 3: The Conclusion features Ajay Devgn, Tabu, Jaideep Ahlawat, Shriya Saran and Prakash Raj. Rolled out in theatres on October 2, 2026, the movie brings the popular crime thriller franchise to its concluding chapter. Drishyam The Conclusion is backed by Star Studio18 and Panorama Studios, with Abhishek Pathak returning to direct the third instalment. He has also co-written the movie with Aamil Keeyan Khan and Parveez Shaikh. Alok Jain, Ajit Andhare, Kumar Mangat Pathak and Abhishek Pathak are producing the movie.

Congratulations to Abhishek Pathak, Kumar Mangat Pathak, Ajay Devgn and the entire cast and crew on a job so well done.”

title: Khosla Ka Ghosla 2 release postponed; Anupam Kher and Boman Irani’s comedy sequel to hit theatres in March 2027
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The Khoslas are coming back, but their return to the big screen will take a little longer than planned. Khosla Ka Ghosla 2 , the sequel to the 2006 comedy that continues to enjoy a loyal fan following, will now rollout in theatres next year. The movie stars Anupam Kher and Boman Irani in lead roles. The sequel was earlier scheduled to arrive in cinemas on August 28, 2026.

Adding to this, Khosla Ka Ghosla 2 rollout date changed: The comedy sequel to hit theatres in March 2027. Rollout date postponed The makers of Khosla Ka Ghosla 2 have revealed March 5, 2027, as the movie’s new rollout date. The team shared the update on social media, along with a new poster. “Deal पक्की! The Khoslas are ready to take possession of cinemas with #KhoslaKaGhosla2, arriving on the big screen on 5th March 2027!” the makers wrote in their announcement.

Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram Anupam Kher, Boman Irani reunite with the original cast Khosla Ka Ghosla 2 will bring back several actors from the first movie, including Anupam Kher, Boman Irani, Tara Sharma, Ranvir Shorey, Kiran Juneja and Parvin Dabas. Ravi Kishan and Divya Khosla Kumar will also be a part of the movie as per the new poster.

Notably, The original Khosla Ka Ghosla, directed by Dibakar Banerjee, told the story of a middle-class family trying to get back a plot of land taken over through fraud. Its humour, familiar family squabbles and take on the struggle to deal with a powerful property dealer struck a chord with viewers. Over the years, the movie collected cult status, with its characters and situations continuing to resonate with audiences.

As per the latest buzz, In January this year, Anupam Kher shared that he wrapped a schedule for Khosla Ka Ghosla 2. He had expressed deep gratitude to the entire team. In a special nod to the project, Anupam posted a video on Instagram featuring glimpses from the movie's sets, showcasing the star in his beloved character, Khosla.

In further updates, Joining him in the photo were his co-stars Ranvir Shorey, Kiran Juneja, and Parvinn Dabass - the ones who portrayed the iconic Khosla family in the first movie. Star Tara Sharma, who was a part of the original movie, also joined the cast for the soon-to-release sequel. Boman Irani, who will reprise his character as Khurana, also featured in the video.

On top of that, "SCHEDULE WRAP OF #KKG2!! As I finish 90% of my work for #KhoslaKaGhosla2 my heart is full of gratitude! It has been an exhausting but an EXHILARATING experience! This is going to be an EPIC sequel to an OG #CultClassic! This time the con is bigger than the biggest! A huge Thank you to each and every cast member (You ALL are Great), all the technicians, writers, director, producers and unit members for their love, warmth and support! Looking forward to meeting you again. Happy rest of the shooting!! Love always!" Anupam had written.
The sequel will now arrive in theatres on March 5, 2027, following the change in its rollout schedule. The makers have also shared a new poster on social media to announce the date.

title: Ahaan Panday's special birthday wish for Saiyaara leading lady Aneet Padda has fans swooning: ‘You’re a gift to the cosmos’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Ahaan Panday , who made his debut in 2025 with the smash hit Saiyaara opposite Aneet Padda , shared a heartfelt note for his co-star on Tuesday, along with a series of unseen pictures and videos of her. But it was his choice of words, calling her “a gift to the cosmos”, that caught everyone’s attention. Followers were quick to read between the lines, with many wondering if the two were confirming their rumoured relationship through the post.

Adding to this, Ahaan Panday’s birthday wish for Aneet Padda has followers swooning: ‘You’re a gift to the cosmos’ Ahaan Panday makes a heartfelt post for Aneet Padda Aneet celebrated her birthday on Tuesday, and Ahaan marked the occasion with a collection of candid moments featuring the star, some from their time travelling together. Along with the pictures, he wrote a message that was as personal as it was poetic. He captioned the post as, “You’re a gift to the cosmos, Aneet, and everything you touch turns to stardust. i hope the universe is always as gentle with you as you are with it, and don’t you ever forget how much light you leave behind; happy happy happy birthday.”

Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram The birthday post also featured the Tamil song Mudhal Nee Mudivum Nee, the title track of the 2021 movie of the same name. Composed by Darbuka Siva, the song is sung by Sid Sriram and Darbuka Siva, with lyrics by Thamarai. Its lyrics include the lines, “You are the beginning. You are the end. You are all three manifestations of time. You are the ocean. You are also the shore.”

Notably, The comments section was soon filled with followers gushing over the post, particularly Ahaan’s words and the music playing in the background. One user wrote, “The songggg and her🌻✨.” Another commented, “Omggggg Ahaan's words for Aneet are literally sooo beautiful💗😭✨.” Someone else simply declared, “OMG hard launch.”

As per the latest buzz, One fan was especially excited to see the star express his affection for Aneet, writing, “Just what we all wanted ❤️❤️❤️❤️ @ahaanpandayy expressing his love openly for @aneetpadda_ 😍😍 Happy Birthday sweet one ! Stay blessed.” Another user lauded the music choice, commenting, “oh song choice goes hard.” One more fan wrote, “omg caption ?!!! FOR HIS STARRY EYED GIRL 🥹🥹🥹.” While the actors have yet to confirm any romantic involvement, their followers clearly aren't ready to stop speculating.

In further updates, Ahaan and Aneet's bond has been under the spotlight ever since they made starred together in Mohit Suri's Saiyaara in 2025. The romantic drama became a major ticket-window success, earning over ₹ 579 crore rupees worldwide on a budget of ₹ 45 crore rupees. It also emerged as the highest-grossing Hindi movie featuring a debutant male lead, turning its two young stars into household names.

On top of that, In an earlier interview with GQ India, he shared, “Aneet is my best friend. The whole internet thinks we’re together, but we’re not. Chemistry isn’t always romantic — it’s about comfort, safety, and being seen. We’ve both made each other feel that. Even though she’s not my girlfriend, I’ll never have a bond like I have with Aneet”

Aneet has also been seen spending time with Ahaan's family. She attended the baby shower of his sister, Alanna Panday, in Mumbai, where she was seen taking part in a fun game with his cousin, Ananya Panday.

title: In 1973, Bollywood's top stars like Dharmendra rejected this movie; the film became a blockbuster that helped revive a struggling actor's career
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood megastar Amitabh Bachchan 's rise to superstardom began with a movie that several established actors had turned down. When Prakash Mehra was casting Zanjeer in 1973, he approached some of Hindi cinema's biggest names, including Dharmendra , Dilip Kumar and Rajesh Khanna. Raaj Kumar was also as per reports considered for the role. Eventually, it was Amitabh, who was struggling to score a box-office hit, who landed the part of Inspector Vijay Khanna. The movie became a turning point in his career and introduced audiences to a hero who was very different from the romantic leads dominating Bollywood at the time.

Adding to this, Bollywood stars like Dharmendra passed on Zanjeer in 1973. Dharmendra was the first choice Dharmendra was among the first actors associated with Zanjeer. He had as per reports bought the story from Salim Khan for ₹ 2,500, with plans to star in it. The project was expected to be a joint production involving his brother Ajit and Prakash Mehra, even before Salim and Javed Akhtar had developed the screenplay.

Meanwhile, However, a fallout between Ajit and Prakash as per reports led Dharmendra to step away from the project. The script eventually returned to Prakash, who was left looking for a leading man. Reports have also suggested that Dilip Kumar was offered the role but declined it.

Notably, Rajesh Khanna was another name linked to the movie. He was at the peak of his popularity in the early 1970s, having won audiences over with his romantic roles. Zanjeer, however, called for a very different kind of performance. Its brooding protagonist offered little of the charm and romance associated with his screen image, and the role eventually went to someone else.

As per the latest buzz, By 1973, Amitabh had spent a few years trying to find his footing in the movie industry. He made his debut with Saat Hindustani in 1969 and collected recognition for his performance in Anand in 1971. But success as a leading man remained elusive, and his string of box-office failures had made him a risky choice for filmmakers.

In further updates, Salim-Javed, however, were convinced that Amitabh had the qualities needed for the role. With several established stars having passed on the project, the writers pushed for the relatively untested star. In an interview with India Today in 2022, Javed recalled just how difficult it had been to find someone willing to take on the movie.

On top of that, “Amitabh Bachchan was actually the last choice for Zanjeer. The script was written for Dharmendra ji, but for some reason, he later refused to work on it. Prakash Mehra now had a script but not a leading man. He was also producing a movie for the first time since he had only directed before that. He went from star to star to offer the role. Some of them are not in this world, while some of them are. Everybody refused to do this movie," he shared.

The writers believed the star could bring the right mix of intensity and anger to Inspector Vijay Khanna. His performance in a fight sequence in Bombay to Goa had as per reports caught their attention, convincing them that he could handle the physical demands of the role. His tall frame, deep voice and ability to convey frustration without saying much made him stand out.

title: Pyre trailer: National Award winner Vinod Kapri’s film tells the heartbreaking story of elderly parents waiting for their children to return
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The trailer of National Award-winning fimmaker Vinod Kapri ’s Pyre is out. It tells the story of an elderly couple who continue to wait for their children, even as life in their Himalayan village grows quieter with each passing day. The trailer offers a glimpse into a world shaped by love, ageing and the loneliness that comes when children move away. Starring two elderly first-time actors from Uttarakhand, the movie has already won 18 international awards.

Adding to this, Pyre trailer out: An elderly couple, an empty home and a wait that never ends. The trailer of Pyre Set in the Kumaon region of Uttarakhand, Pyre follows Padam Singh and Tulsi, an elderly couple who spend their days together in their mountain home. Their children have left the village in search of better opportunities, leaving the two to deal with the silence and uncertainty that come with growing old without family around. The trailer captures the small moments that define their lives, bringing into focus the emotional cost of migration for parents who stay behind while their children build lives elsewhere.

Meanwhile, Pyre features Padam Singh Kapri, 80, and Heera Devi, 70, neither of whom had acted before the movie. Both are residents of Uttarakhand, and their connection to the region adds a personal touch to the story. Padam Singh, a retired Army serviceman, plays a character named after himself, while Heera Devi takes on the role of Tulsi. Their performances bring the movie closer to the lives of the people and communities it portrays.

Notably, Filmed entirely in the mountains of Uttarakhand, Pyre has collected recognition at international festivals, picking up 18 awards, including 15 Best Movie honours. These include awards at festivals and events in Washington, D.C., Chicago, Canada, Spain, Boston, Stuttgart, London and Birmingham. The movie has also won Best Director awards in Serbia and Boston, along with honours for its music, cinematography and sound.

As per the latest buzz, Talking about the movie finally reaching Indian audiences, producer-director Vinod Kapri shared, “I’m delighted that Pyre will finally reach audiences across India in cinemas, where its emotions and the beauty of the Himalayas can be experienced on the big screen. The movie has received so much warmth and appreciation on its international journey, and now I’m looking forward to sharing this deeply personal story with audiences back home and hoping it touches their hearts just as much,” shared Vinod.

In further updates, Before its nationwide theatrical rollout, the makers will take Pyre to Berinag, Bageshwar and Srinagar Garhwal through special screenings scheduled from October 14 to 17. The screenings will be organised with Picture Time, a mobile theatre initiative that brings cinema to places with limited or no access to permanent theatres. The idea is to ensure that audiences in the region where the movie was made also get an opportunity to watch it on the big screen.

On top of that, The movie is produced by Vinod Kapri, Suresh Joshi and Arindra Rai Chaudhuri under Bhagirathi Films and Mashakbeen Studios. It will rollout in theatres across India on October 30 in Hindi and Malayalam.

title: CRPF officer files complaint over alleged mistreatment of women protesters by Delhi police, CAPF
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

A serving Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) officer posted in Manipur filed a complaint with the National Human Rights Commission (NHRC), Delhi police and National Commission for Women(NCW) seeking action against Central Armed Police Force (CAPF) and Delhi police “personnel physically mistreating women protesters.” Assistant commandant Rahul Solanki shared in his complaint that he was submitting it in his personal capacity as a “concerned citizen”.

Adding to this, Solanki wrote in his letter that he requests appropriate directions and gender sensitivity training for police personnel deployed on the ground, particularly in handling women protesters. (Reuters) Solanki attached three links to videos from social media which, he shared, prima facie show police and CAPF personnel physically mistreating women.

Meanwhile, “I do not claim to have independently verified the footage. I request an impartial investigation and forensic verification of the videos, including examination of the complete incident footage and relevant circumstances. If the allegations are substantiated, appropriate legal then departmental action may be taken against the personnel and supervisory officers found responsible. If the footage is found to be fabricated or materially manipulated, appropriate legal action and removal of misleading content may be pursued in accordance with law,” the complaint shared.
Notably, Solanki wrote in his letter that he requests appropriate directions and gender sensitivity training for police personnel deployed on the ground, particularly in handling women protesters.

As per the latest buzz, The assistant commandant reiterated that he acknowledges and appreciates the duties performed by police and CAPF personnel, and that the complaint was not intended to undermine their service but to “ensure that any genuine misconduct is addressed fairly”.
In further updates, Among all security forces, CRPF forms the largest component of the forces deployed in Delhi.

On top of that, People aware of the matter shared that the Supreme Court on Tuesday sought the personal presence of a senior Delhi police officer to explain the alleged assault on women journalists during the recent protests in Delhi.

Chief Justice of India Surya Kant made the observation after senior advocate Indira Jaising mentioned a petition filed by the Network of Women in Media, India (NWMI), which seeks safeguards for journalists covering protests, particularly women journalists.

title: Exclusive| Naomi Ackie had to ‘audition hard’ to enter DC universe
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

BAFTA winning star Naomi Ackie who has featured in films like Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker and Whitney Houston: I Wanna Dance with Somebody, will next be seen in DC's psychological thriller movie, Clayface. Clayface is a classic Batman villain. In an exclusive chat with HTCity she says, "Its DC and horror, two of my favourite genres coming together. The script was complex and heartfelt, elements I did not expect to be in the movie. I just had to audition hard to get it." She describes her character scientist Dr. Caitlyn Corr as "ambitious, protective and data based" adding, "She builds a connection with someone that she thinks she can help but does not anticipate what that connection grows into."

Adding to this, Naomi Ackie And what awaits Batman followers in this one? She says, "It's an origin story so we are focusing on where he comes from. It's horror merged with his comic book character. Also, what he looks like in the end, the transformation is fascinating, it's a body horror movie. Expect having more empathy than you normally would for the origin story of a villain and, a lot of heart, funny moments along with horror. The days Tom (Rhys Harries) would show up in prosthetics were fascinating. I would want to touch it but also not. I remember overhearing Tom and James (Watkins, director) discussing prosthetics because it's about misshaping your face and expressions show up differently." She describes the transformation as "fascinating yet scary."
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by HT City (@htcity)

Notably, Naomi who has also been to India multiple times in the recent past, first attended the Dior Pre-Fall 2023 fashion show in Mumbai. She says, "I visited Mumbai first; it was so beautiful with so much to see. I remember going for a drive and ending up at a market and I was overwhelmed with the number of people. Everything was so loud. A year later I ended up in Keralam and it was the opposite—so quiet. I've been to Keralam twice and I can't wait to go again. Keralam is one of my favourite places."

As per the latest buzz, Having starred in some exciting projects through her career she says she is "satisfied and connect" adding "I just want to tell fun stories that people connect to, I dont have the pressure of having to prove myself. It's a good place to be in."

title: Delhi HC seeks Centre’s response on SOPs to regulate protests, lists plea for Friday
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Delhi high court on Tuesday sought the Centre’s response in a petition seeking implementation of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to regulate protests and prevent disruptions to traffic and businesses amid demonstrations demanding the resignation of chief election commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar.

Adding to this, On October 10, security personnel turned the Capital into a fortress to thwart the planned protest, launching an unprecedented clampdown that saw the detention of 7,000 people. (Reuters) A bench of acting chief justice Nitin Sambre and justice Sanjay Sharma asked Centre’s lawyer additional solicitor general Chetan Sharma to seek instructions and listed the petition filed by advocate Rishabh Saxena, a traders body and Santosh Kushwaha, a street vendor for Friday.
Meanwhile, “In the meantime, we direct the respondents to take instructions in the matter,” the court shared in the order.

Notably, Senior advocate Sacchin Puri and Sanjay Poddar, appearing for the petitioners, submitted that the protests were disrupting business activities and urged the court to direct that demonstrations be held at designated sites to ensure that professionals and businesses are not affected.

As per the latest buzz, The petition shared that the Supreme Court, in Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan v. Union of India, had directed the Commissioner of Police to formulate a regulatory mechanism for protests. Following the directions, binding conditions were laid down for demonstrations, including a prohibition on blocking traffic, office gates and arterial roads.

In further updates, Saxena’s petition further shared that at 2pm on October 12, while travelling to the Competent Authority’s office on Barakhamba Road, New Delhi, in connection with a professional matter, he encountered a gathering of people occupying the carriageway and the central traffic island near the Mandi House roundabout.

On top of that, “The incident of 12.10.2026 is not an isolated one. Between 01.01.2022 and 12.10.2026, at least 82 major agitations were held at Jantar Mantar, several of them sit-ins lasting over a month, with attempted marches towards Parliament. Press reports show that the overall number of protests at the site has been rising: 292 protests between January and March 2025, against 202 in the same period of 2024. Sit-ins lasting weeks, marches and gatherings spilling onto the surrounding roads are, on their face, inconsistent with the conditions of Standing Order,” the petition shared.

Apart from the petitions seeking implementation of the SOPs governing protests, the court also heard a plea filed by National Students’ Union of India (NSUI) president Vinod Jhakhar, seeking an investigation by a Special Investigation Team (SIT) into the alleged assault on members of the public by anti-social elements during a protest demanding CEC’s resignation on October 10. The plea sought the identification of those involved and appropriate legal action against them.

title: ‘Who is this Rajkummar Rao?’ Ujjwal Nikam didn’t know who the actor was before Prahaar
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Rajkummar Rao’s next movie is the highly anticipated Prahaar: The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam, based on the life of Ujjwal Nikam , who represented the prosecution in the trial of Ajmal Kasab, the lone surviving terrorist of the 26/11 Mumbai attacks. During a recent interaction, Nikam opened up that he did not know who Rajkummar Rao was when the movie's director Avinash Arun first suggested the star’s name to play him on the big screen.

Adding to this, Rajkummar Rao plays former public prosecutor Ujjwal Nikam in Prahaar. (Anshuman Poyrekar/HT Photo) Ujjwal Nikam didn’t know who Rajkummar Rao was In conversation with NDTV, Ujjwal Nikam shared that when Avinash Arun informed him that Rajkummar Rao would play his role in Prahaar, he immediately asked him one question: “Avinash ji, who is this Rajkummar?”

Meanwhile, Avinash then told Nikam about Rajkummar Rao’s career and his performances. After hearing the director praise Rajkummar, Nikam visited the movie’s set one day to watch the shoot. He was impressed after seeing the star perform and meeting him in person.

Notably, “He is down-to-earth and simple. He doesn't have that star tantrum. He's a real star,” Nikam shared while praising Rajkummar during the interview. He also complimented the director for choosing the right star to portray him on screen.
As per the latest buzz, Rajkummar, meanwhile, has shared that he did not spend time with Nikam before the shoot and instead watched his videos to prepare for the role.

In further updates, In another interaction with India Today, Nikam shared the conditions he had put before the makers before allowing them to make a movie about a significant phase of his career and life. He shared he wanted the story to remain grounded in reality, without glorifying any of the people involved in the legal proceedings.

On top of that, He shared, “My first condition was that there should be no glorification of any character, including myself. I also told them to use real names of all the characters who had participated in this legal proceeding and the makers took no objection certificate from the concerned people, including the judge, Mr Madan Laxmandas Tahaliyani.”

Prahaar: The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam is an soon-to-release courtroom drama produced by Dinesh Vijan under Maddock Films. Rajkummar Rao plays Ujjwal Nikam.The movie also stars Wamiqa Gabbi, Jaideep Ahlawat, Sikandar Kher and Marathi star Lalit Prabhakar, who plays Ajmal Kasab. The movie is scheduled to rollout in theatres on October 16, 2026.

title: Centre forms panel to probe first year student's death at IIIT-Ranchi amid protests
body: Here's the latest protest news from across India:

The Ministry of Education has constituted a three-member committee to examine the circumstances surrounding the death by suicide of a first-year student at Indian Institute of Information Technology, Ranchi, and assess whether the institute implemented guidelines on student well-being.

Adding to this, Students stage a protest outside a hostel after a first-year student allegedly died by suicide at the Indian Institute of Information Technology in Ranchi, on Sunday. (PTI) The development came amid continuous protests at IIIT-Ranchi over allegations that the college administration did not provide emergency timely medical assistance to the student, who died on the night of October 10. The students have demanded the resignation of institute director Rajeev Srivastava and better emergency medical facilities on campus.

Meanwhile, The Centre’s committee, chaired by Prof Rajni Abbi, director of the University of Delhi’s South Campus, has been given 15 days to submit its report. The panel also comprises Dr Jitendra Nagpal, a senior psychiatrist at Delhi’s Moolchand Hospital, and Heera Lal Poonia, deputy secretary in the ministry’s department of higher education. The ministry formed the panel through an order dated October 12.

Notably, The committee will examine the implementation of the ministry’s July 2023 framework and guidelines for emotional and mental wellbeing of students in Higher Education Institutions (HEIs), besides reviewing the availability of basic facilities, institutional support systems, counselling and mentoring arrangements and student grievance redressal mechanisms. The July 2023 guidelines seek to promote student well-being and address mental health concerns in HEIs.

As per the latest buzz, “The incident necessitates a closer examination of the implementation of these measures at the institutional level and identify any deficiencies requiring corrective action,” the ministry shared in its order.

In further updates, The order also shared the committee will “ascertain systemic challenges and areas requiring strengthening” in the institute’s arrangements for promoting student well-being and responding to psychological distress. Besides, the panel will review existing student grievance redressal mechanisms and their effectiveness, and recommend interventions to “prevent the recurrence of such incidents and to promote students’ wellbeing.”

On top of that, In a statement on Tuesday, the ministry shared the panel would “interact with stakeholders and examine relevant records and documents as required”. It added that it also undertaking “suitable interim administrative arrangements” to ensure the institute’s smooth functioning, keeping in view students’ interests and well-being.

IIT registrar Munuren Samson Champia earlier shared the institute’s chairperson visited the protested site and held talks with the students “in an attempt to defuse the tense situation”. “However, a standoff ensued before formal discussions could begin. The examinations, which began on October 8, could not be held on Monday due to the agitation,” Champia shared.

Former Jawaharlal Nehru University Students’ Union president N Sai Balaji was also present.

Notably, A senior Congress leader shared bringing students on board was a calculated move to broaden the Opposition’s base in the protest against Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar. On top of that, The petition raises concerns over the “unilateral and arbitrary exercise” of the election body's collective powers by CEC Gyanesh Kumar during the ongoing Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls, the integrity of the electoral process, and the alleged infringement of eligible citizens’ constitutional right to register as voters and exercise their right to vote.
